Photosynthesis is the vital process by which green plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFStGT5kXrW_j0LwZn4EUOVm2ILI7pejYNy2CQSZoI53r9MwEJdagA7nWTRTVEWOna0w_UbVvRAY517Frw4aPbfZP79zQJ4bMbCZu408GTb3jLGlI_0fa43CEroKyOoxKC1MFuwrRYVfq2prcs=) [monash](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFHj8-vqVXrwSpD4x1f8iM3LHmYSCsgXU45Md-bEdf4_7Yh4lyhICha3_4Qp0OK_m6gzv48qw_Uw3kCiejjQ4xtTrBQ-xDGBVw5FKL6KjTkdKnvuZrpnymAAPKFAaMUKZGMzMBsYzrB72UHaWB1SNkPUqRrUG_Jx_t01nxM78S3jy02kWuSxwqWwU76AAFMIg5RXFGgwQCStl2JUBD7OrI=) [berkeley](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFErNfK--Vuf8ui6CJGRlbWbfHdKGnpGpiMdxXaloi9KUkdFm1aPMm9XMXyQcAwCU1GVE_LxWzB9BJxeWh8z1dvZMnh1lI4CZsgNNpfsWpP4Hb-2xOtnI1B7iHLfhb_kAihDO34eUgILiWWCzn9PVUvJnmmWNyn). This process utilizes sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce oxygen and energy-rich organic compounds, primarily sugars. The general chemical equation representing photosynthesis is 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFStGT5kXrW_j0LwZn4EUOVm2ILI7pejYNy2CQSZoI53r9MwEJdagA7nWTRTVEWOna0w_UbVvRAY517Frw4aPbfZP79zQJ4bMbCZu408GTb3jLGlI_0fa43CEroKyOoxKC1MFuwrRYVfq2prcs=) [monash](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFHj8-vqVXrwSpD4x1f8iM3LHmYSCsgXU45Md-bEdf4_7Yh4lyhICha3_4Qp0OK_m6gzv48qw_Uw3kCiejjQ4xtTrBQ-xDGBVw5FKL6KjTkdKnvuZrpnymAAPKFAaMUKZGMzMBsYzrB72UHaWB1SNkPUqRrUG_Jx_t01nxM78S3jy02kWuSxwqWwU76AAFMIg5RXFGgwQCStl2JUBD7OrI=) [berkeley](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFErNfK--Vuf8ui6CJGRlbWbfHdKGnpGpiMdxXaloi9KUkdFm1aPMm9XMXyQcAwCU1GVE_LxWzB9BJxeWh8z1dvZMnh1lI4CZsgNNpfsWpP4Hb-2xOtnI1B7iHLfhb_kAihDO34eUgILiWWCzn9PVUvJnmmWNyn).

The importance of photosynthesis cannot be overstated; it serves as the fundamental energy source for nearly all life on Earth, forming the base of food webs [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFStGT5kXrW_j0LwZn4EUOVm2ILI7pejYNy2CQSZoI53r9MwEJdagA7nWTRTVEWOna0w_UbVvRAY517Frw4aPbfZP79zQJ4bMbCZu408GTb3jLGlI_0fa43CEroKyOoxKC1MFuwrRYVfq2prcs=) [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGZlMTqf-7kCr_YLJGvdfjhPq9dmeRamJcQiOa_8BEc6ipHUQ8jvSruVSyVZg8HFlIYUau9_1eT-Pp7kVKNM5XDVDgmGA7-Py9h-k5RUWP0uxYWC1sNMhSVfmhCMsochVx27VrxTHMfol-FktFdio8jB1QW9SYMV_M6A7MEg0g=) [berkeley](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFErNfK--Vuf8ui6CJGRlbWbfHdKGnpGpiMdxXaloi9KUkdFm1aPMm9XMXyQcAwCU1GVE_LxWzB9BJxeWh8z1dvZMnh1lI4CZsgNNpfsWpP4Hb-2xOtnI1B7iHLfhb_kAihDO34eUgILiWWCzn9PVUvJnmmWNyn). It is also responsible for the oxygen in our atmosphere, and the fossil fuels that power industrial society are derived from ancient photosynthetic activity [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFStGT5kXrW_j0LwZn4EUOVm2ILI7pejYNy2CQSZoI53r9MwEJdagA7nWTRTVEWOna0w_UbVvRAY517Frw4aPbfZP79zQJ4bMbCZu408GTb3jLGlI_0fa43CEroKyOoxKC1MFuwrRYVfq2prcs=) [britannica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGZlMTqf-7kCr_YLJGvdfjhPq9dmeRamJcQiOa_8BEc6ipHUQ8jvSruVSyVZg8HFlIYUau9_1eT-Pp7kVKNM5XDVDgmGA7-Py9h-k5RUWP0uxYWC1sNMhSVfmhCMsochVx27VrxTHMfol-FktFdio8jB1QW9SYMV_M6A7MEg0g=). Recent studies have indicated that terrestrial plants have contributed to an increase in global photosynthesis, although this is partially counteracted by a decrease in marine algae [duke](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGv0cMlfDrRpcsP1o_yoimVnirm5UCn_tA4yNplzkdCf747rFDG9dtuAWmkejdDNSUR7yAApAhdG8U5oyXvG0fSlddnXnMR4EjdnzcYELFGu1J_R2vgaCnmHMveYKEJH_CFtXbQ7PpzVIoWMuldPXr32NKeEtjCT4jZO3hgXHD9rXRNUvQRHGL7kaHv7ISjMatlDJVZonpZJPU7MaoS1f9_9DY=).

Scientific understanding and application of photosynthesis are continually advancing. Recent breakthroughs in 2025 have shed new light on how plants manage light energy within photosystem II (PSII), revealing a flexible energy transport system that balances light harvesting with protection from excess light [lbl](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFwjojJGJLnWusExjO-IodBoAz4SpunTUD1KaGxJXS2-njhJi0aSRpyyKS1Qvc45YLnrIZDcQXfs_2b9b0AUT4KEWG8C-wpX0Uh0fKvU48FMM_ckmXaXNEp_gjx3IVo1r9rADeDKXb7LjfRHjph-jI5otFpchLZ6KljioiQf9mN9nlR45bNKihEUI3M_tl-cSO2_wO4JcRrXXRvmOaBShKfSTFx9ftYiZVSmPg=). Further research has identified key mechanisms regulating chloroplast development, which could lead to improved crop productivity [lbl](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFwjojJGJLnWusExjO-IodBoAz4SpunTUD1KaGxJXS2-njhJi0aSRpyyKS1Qvc45YLnrIZDcQXfs_2b9b0AUT4KEWG8C-wpX0Uh0fKvU48FMM_ckmXaXNEp_gjx3IVo1r9rADeDKXb7LjfRHjph-jI5otFpchLZ6KljioiQf9mN9nlR45bNKihEUI3M_tl-cSO2_wO4JcRrXXRvmOaBShKfSTFx9ftYiZVSmPg=), and new methods allow real-time observation of plants' carbon and water exchange, aiding the development of drought-resistant crops [purdue](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEQjeMtdlh4DEMoRzvm682kLgsebSgLMFKjuuGlLbllAJ4LKfmD_5bi2JbpUttIbQv9-fYOO0laj3k9x5fyNj0m6XobRxf9p0FQHCnSfjK9bMNoYZYXOfWp6xj4cdumU9S1Zcs7Hb2XrI4uV3UjYy3FgzKvqbFVHtxYni4myC6SqAzyb2Bh0chQ_FnhAOpPKj0Rn1EN2DgTjLwmHCuQuBiltx1lobBnDTEhppEBLTw5_XSBWg5k9v_Sp8Nf9bXC).

The field of artificial photosynthesis is also making significant strides, with the development of new catalysts and nanomaterials to mimic the natural process. code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

kwargs.question: How does the human brain process information?

output:
The human brain processes information through a complex and dynamic interplay of neural structures, functions, and advanced computational approaches. Recent research highlights several key aspects of this intricate process:

*   **Neural Connectivity and Function:** The brain's physical wiring, or neural connectivity, is strongly indicative of its function. A detailed map, released in November 2025, provides compelling evidence that the brain's structure dictates specialized regional purposes and predicts mental functions across the entire brain. This "connectivity fingerprint" is particularly associated with higher-level cognitive skills like language and memory [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGfK63Iqn_myFRqtebeMGYDdG3pre554UJaCTlAiE6GHJuc6wdhIAwBQOm6On9jU40dn4dk5AtFfxWO3Bl-VSbdNJTinlzab3wlx3gwRazf3wSdLGt5_TfEe5k5YvvV9xO6Bzc6cWsd2g8EloOgrMAYBlbj-lWm5fU=). Understanding these patterns is crucial for comparing healthy and disordered brains [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGfK63Iqn_myFRqtebeMGYDdG3pre554UJaCTlAiE6GHJuc6wdhIAwBQOm6On9jU40dn4dk5AtFfxWO3Bl-VSbdNJTinlzab3wlx3gwRazf3wSdLGt5_TfEe5k5YvvV9xO6Bzc6cWsd2g8EloOgrMAYBlbj-lWm5fU=).

*   **Artificial Intelligence in Neuroscience:** AI, especially machine learning and neural networks, is indispensable for dissecting complex brain activity and decoding neural pathways. These AI models are designed to mimic brain architecture, enabling the analysis of intricate data patterns related to cognitive functions and advancing personalized medicine for neurological conditions [trendsresearch](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEoGy7DIxxNlh23VxR3VIkdn3jDUtFqzhbW0VvBV8ONv5WfyLikHs_xNZFUQcsUu77uzZSqg0oDOy0D-bBhvR5YcsZvYxlOwhc8uASPBl0GnL4X1WZI-PrGUKpPDWQ77DZVQlctLHw9xSmk2wfqIUefsWbIx_c9c6fHFQ3n6VvuoAox8cn8ItTHRLBTxg==). AI also plays a vital role in constructing detailed 3D brain maps, as demonstrated by a May 2024 study that utilized AI to create the highest-resolution map of human brain tissue to date [braininitiative](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGPrI8JYzcXLc_Be3GwyzIhFoMHL3kQAH6QQTDwyCLH4tjRSEpQn_Vl6tbXVEijagNATZEfxHXc9WCu1EMGj5KobeWsg_ALCOXxMDe8PF3FnaG9GqOHn7mmJp_toxDoSuXa2lsVCIIPEEEOukWMROsSPYufSxJ5374BgsyUEektkVUdh1QOi-cs8rAbRDaRPDN0jA0Vmv8zYxYIF-nDmH1jVK0IKzOtsXTm2dUz). Deep learning algorithms, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, are proving highly effective for decoding neural activity, significantly outperforming traditional methods [consensus](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFUugZUaZUAXAnoaUWNH4rmtl9Lfd9RFJLsPXvCiogho6JwlDgFCsHgHvhoxWY4IJJ69IfmZyo5dzx6r7Aqo91NCLHkmkBxxk3UIJxIhckTq25hWsHiqHQ4nBqdHB-Y80TVFFgZf8pGq65hXIh5J00mHpADLPjELhft-kXgnOaT-WvMIKPTwvoXP-K3p1D_kThGNVXMo-r2zgB5yjI6Wjohyr4=).

*   **Learning and Information Processing:** The brain's learning processes are distinct from current AI learning principles [ox](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHsyhrUxyckB8v6OUUFYYvtFjaljHTWoURptngtLMRTCIeEjUTP6PugiSutEf9YmdnJYbCmXcRYCIG5ipmd62BEgEXxE7GO3FsSWAtuKDSaTSa6SYxA_e6QkgCnQ1XN6wKorWkOP2W_Pa2l_v2s1fsSWYXLjB9cWq43Hqf0cw0BBY4Ict8CFDiYpsZJvnLa0w8-JSUq-YMe0x1voq7BajuRK-8kuLoixbLJxE0tapqj). Research from April 2025 illuminates how changes across synapses and neurons facilitate learning, offering insights for neurological disorders and the development of brain-like AI systems [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEDBp6cvCsn8t_Vk_XCpYGybeUe8PC4Wg54iTRL6OUDugpn00Q_Yw-EQTLAcUFFHda5pAKxH8prZ8NakjfzXHOWnbIV5hafVkdlTTjFIjIGvvphQG1ZcL-fxEjPm-5C-26ULycpaczLiMMu1pkPjWJ62noRas2G4Yw=). The brain dynamically organizes its regions into pathways based on task demands, a phenomenon simulated by AI models known as "Mixture-of-Pathways" (MoP) [arxiv](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHB8nKEmK9Zq3VQdMx6h-dDtx6GlEr5HJnpeNK5x1uUUHEjdsjQ-QvPdr6XZiYg0k8-ZIZMqEWb98d9D_FHt5ZnUxTOWk7qPIGaLqfbF6yhBN8D8O3zwdVYOKo=). These MoP models use heterogeneous "expert" networks and a dynamic routing system, guided by specific inductive biases such as routing cost and performance-based scaling, to mimic how the brain forms task-specific pathways [jachterberg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG5V0VkKPjGYofZGnMC522NHxdO0R205YhwQziN9--Mq9KEpLr3wtoT_WtLIjbowVIs_ekedESUdVphmIXDfPjjVvEOuL_cN8Rt08sAFixqrsqJ5WQnI9atAG_Y7UDY0t4G0sguhAFfGSDxLb0=).

*   **Neural Timescales and Information Integration:** The brain integrates information processed at different speeds, with distinct regions operating on varying timescales, known as intrinsic neural timescales (INTs) [drugs](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH-KmpoO8oU_3twINgILdu2wUqhZXVCpI5tYqoqsXkUWQTq1zTOB_qZ8O5f32R_fcsO26shPlDULNSp1ZwSQ140LfFELg2z8ffYChRg-qicGVxmbnkRYrLrvAQ7Q-QaEgDpjocdUHx-9n6TGUeBVxzzPv5vgZNlSyN1dDbP3lkdJuS-OltQqCG7cBNpj24YOcrqKEnagBcf). These timescales, influenced by white-matter pathways and shaped by genetics, can predict cognitive abilities [drugs](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH-KmpoO8oU_3twINgILdu2wUqhZXVCpI5tYqoqsXkUWQTq1zTOB_qZ8O5f32R_fcsO26shPlDULNSp1ZwSQ140LfFELg2z8ffYChRg-qicGVxmbnkRYrLrvAQ7Q-QaEgDpjocdUHx-9n6TGUeBVxzzPv5vgZNlSyN1dDbP3lkdJuS-OltQqCG7cBNpj24YOcrqKEnagBcf) [neurosciencenews](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHTM89YBqeRpl8g2ViRhLd8xY2YzkBVYvpLFkYdDccywGBLpdbQzHv-tM3yBVi2BT3rmdrTECVoDM1S20lMXhPJuLVd_wgn5BEJOWBdXh5nSCPDRn72rlE=).

*   **Memory Encoding and Retrieval:** Memory encoding and retrieval are dynamic processes that can occur simultaneously. The brain modulates its activity, often linked to theta and gamma brainwave oscillations, with specific theta phases favoring encoding and others retrieval [alliedacademies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEr9WM7D5Dow_2QjbuR0MHyBlLWyj4dyqjS3QIDK4p1xaoiOdi0ov2ZHqXn5eQD8izRyk3BVX0_uHeC1icnh7RN4OA9jKIA1sPr27N8Y1t5AreR1vA8b5ufTcsLvuTfHu_eA-xyTi3mhslLj_W5_3B1X3sw3Sa6d375sSQU8hyFribSVklV4b22OJes2wBVQoGuY453f0ie-JI3OYgdyNf3RFuYR5y3rMDDPqQtaomKzUFgM4TpgM3lCxQuA5FC_xlmIU73fO8=). The hippocampus is key for encoding new memories, while synaptic plasticity strengthens neural connections for storage. Memories are distributed across neural networks as engrams, and even forgotten memories can leave implicit traces that influence behavior [alliedacademies](https://vertexaisearch.ko.cloud.google.com/id/1-0) [elifesciences](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG328IsSTqKCIST7HGeznIsuhKlqW7EtJS3vN-yM14UDMnFGyRuIfIcD_TRbDds3wnhrQtT0qjlHLxx_EPKzWDIlmOIeW29U-VeipiQG0MygWRBpH_NL2kDBKWQl8yyHrVzBeScdf7ERRop9wKfrA==). Advanced neuroimaging reveals that the temporal sequence of events is encoded by specific neurons [notebookcheck](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQENkQH2B6Ssn9tBZ2W0_ac76kjQCdyJiW9NhxhwgP6jgFv0HprkbMs8-AlPJtflJ3jR8OD3Sqpir6h1CCNfoCHODge46OQon1lGa-S2GWawvMpgdpdi-udhqJfIPt1e4nmP9BYmnFMgY3K-1vSI1sgcaVBkcGopqaAndbBgsLqE1HP2qw-mFZZhXQTI-MpIMAlrXD5w1j1tmZeJNQhHMGfZOpSNsvLloi3QdoQFNG_0tBb5Fd2nQ0e9B6ipGRq0oOPJpD53UA==) [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEV9G1yB2scg1EhyqAUOhYGLNQ2hcTEA8dVH9JPZytFelkbbrmeF5zVfdK9zXPVwUrzSt1sZ8TGVjdg3zKYTnROkFzHz8MQ2BJVHgRPuOrA42ephtCApcgCMoJ4psFPQ-irdYD0p1xbknYpt1urLMiyCbgSxE4roVaC).

*   **Computational Models and Brain Simulation:** Sophisticated computational models are crucial for understanding the brain. Researchers are developing large-scale simulations of the human brain, aiming to understand how massive neural networks exhibit complex behaviors [futurism](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEfW17Y-TJTu6jrWJGc5N3w9x9U5M1wXRPK0D7ylZjvCog2-KZoD67BuIMZbWsiOu-rAjGpPrhUjZP-RIroXR0UJRaNhC1Mw3_e_lyn4tVRq2eSwK6BfJ65OErXJmFNFpKK1OS0sxGQbSn6wtr-6BUzcKygHmXq3eN6IQ8dmDSFeNU=). Neuromorphic computing, inspired by the brain's architecture, integrates memory and computation, utilizes event-driven processing, and employs massively parallel structures to achieve greater energy efficiency and speed [ijrdo](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF5IYsAM1MM08SM8nQ6l8fs1_L0EvY3sNkcrghq2FXO83OK21rAWy7-KdaEExsZ0FSKkpnjauea1fzGEwAWpEINw0RTZwX0B_n4ByHm3sWYCaBlLH6DVOW7_Is2ULyjkZYO_8CA1NFYnujMVa0FYraIHM_ueAHT_VQ0Gw==). AI is also enabling the decoding of internal speech and word categories from brain activity, with potential applications for communication aids [eurekalert](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGvaziHYdB1Spc19FmdbqhdgrxWOcfZs21ajchH91e0vOInNAfs2dkR2zeFq49KmLNEkMCAM7UgchBrHz2V1cvpEpokwZ31wZg0lndXPHMEsJ3H07gO2hCt5cFOjfVNRdH695vO8eV8OXnC).

*   **Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) and Therapies:** Progress in BCIs allows for the decoding of intentions, such as internal speech, from neural activity for assistive communication [neurotrackerx](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFMHjYRHmCoU_S2pHkUCyzI2ZZtwzSatLPbG-RfUMDRRD2m2ufpWMsP3liMnhaSj_JFLeL3Bf74IWFk7Z5XLHgNEKmYUFqVGgGp9kOT5PDTZv8ParqEbZc3bNXzzkEkhiXLYs9fekyiZQKCqBk8jQvkFlIjpc2eo91cu-5wmk0enP1k__Ze7N4EIYZwBEjhyxkLxRkDu-vXM9FC_oQQx19KkeP9SGW6q42Ax7o=). Memory prosthetics are also being developed, with stimulation techniques showing promise for improving memory recall [neurotrackerx](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFMHjYRHmCoU_S2pHkUCyzI2ZZtwzSatLPbG-RfUMDRRD2m2ufpWMsP3liMnhaSj_JFLeL3Bf74IWFk7Z5XLHgNEKmYUFqVGgGp9kOT5PDTZv8ParqEbZc3bNXzzkEkhiXLYs9fekyiZQKCqBk8jQvkFlIjpc2eo91cu-5wmk0enP1k__Ze7N4EIYZwBEjhyxkLxRkDu-vXM9FC_oQQx19KkeP9SGW6q42Ax7o=). New methods for genetic therapy delivery to the brain are also advancing towards non-invasive treatments for neurological disorders [braininitiative](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGPrI8JYzcXLc_Be3GwyzIhFoMHL3kQAH6QQTDwyCLH4tjRSEpQn_Vl6tbXVEijagNATZEfxHXc9WCu1EMGj5KobeWsg_ALCOXxMDe8PF3FnaG9GqOHn7mmJp_toxDoSuXa2lsVCIIPEEEOukWMROsSPYufSxJ5374BgsyUEektkVUdh1QOi-cs8rAbRDaRPDN0jA0Vmv8zYxYIF-nDmH1jVK0IKzOtsXTm2dUz).

@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

kwargs.question: What are black holes and how are they formed?

output:
Black holes are regions of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape. Their formation is a complex and dynamic area of research, with several theories attempting to explain their origins, particularly for supermassive black holes observed in the early universe.

### Theories of Black Hole Formation:

**1. Stellar Black Hole Formation:**
Stellar black holes are formed from the collapse of massive stars. This typically occurs when a star's core exceeds the Chandrasekhar limit (approximately 3 solar masses) after a supernova explosion, leading to gravitational collapse [astronomyonline](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFL6O7K1sOwFDqO5dBleZMM9sXErirmQpsiAGOQdwdxI_YZVXSY9x7abO-L6ks4JmhYjvpgGat8GqwypOEQqTyWO3jNLuP8JLTD-zhL2Xxxaoc9LMUu-vA09lV5iDTShtmtLHBRYsyvJt11). Other pathways include:
*   **Accretion onto compact stellar remnants:** A white dwarf or neutron star in a binary system can accrete matter from its companion, leading to collapse if the remnant exceeds the Chandrasekhar limit [astronomyonline](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFL6O7K1sOwFDqO5dBleZMM9sXErirmQpsiAGOQdwdxI_YZVXSY9x7abO-L6ks4JmhYjvpgGat8GqwypOEQqTyWO3jNLuP8JLTD-zhL2Xxxaoc9LMUu-vA09lV5iDTShtmtLHBRYsyvJt11).
*   **Merger of compact stellar remnants:** The merger of two neutron stars can result in a combined mass that triggers black hole formation [astronomyonline](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFL6O7K1sOwFDqO5dBleZMM9sXErirmQpsiAGOQdwdxI_YZVXSY9x7abO-L6ks4JmhYjvpgGat8GqwypOEQqTyWO3jNLuP8JLTD-zhL2Xxxaoc9LMUu-vA09lV5iDTShtmtLHBRYsyvJt11).
Recent gravitational wave detections from events like GW241011 and GW241110 suggest that some stellar-mass black holes are "second-generation" objects, formed through hierarchical merging in dense environments like star clusters [astronomy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHjdXqJbBKIxmRem9CN5pwXbxmGBWdB-v6wLEnAR8BUfuNewfEj5c4zyenUyqilfoI2NY2W0OV2J8scZrMZMYMDu_VF71wLW0LySsGJRlPngRjaRcs4IkIcxVb1DVawrhOlVSNIyIlIcFKsE9h8kFFbjXVIKco9hvQvH-2TlrFE38JcmhMOExxpA_nf1pmSDKbVZQ==). The detection of exceptionally massive black holes, such as GW231123 with a mass of 225 solar masses, also challenges current formation models and suggests they may form from earlier mergers [cbsnews](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGWVgNZMd750Jf7B0yF2JU9XtLviN2BI_zuGP5lQPDPaub7iPY5G9y2bL2fk7w5vZXI09LkbnbUP__UXCoGDeVwe_trGrDjOgCKCcvHy6AB3fcMJggT4LupbU37AGLrusToiiRGpqL1a_2ooIfrvuKtya6NfRD8WPCcFizqumeJ4VgzK2Xo7c4ELXW_7Kdz8pbiECr05BY=).

**2. Supermassive Black Hole Formation:**
The formation of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in the early universe is still not fully understood, but several key theories are being explored:

*   **Light Seed Theory:** This theory proposes that small black holes form from the collapse of a star's core, followed by a supernova. These initial black holes, up to about 1,000 solar masses, then merge over time to grow larger. However, the rapid growth of SMBHs observed in the early universe challenges this model, as mergers may not be fast enough [nasa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFBvM_B_6QZVqpB6mYVFfIRYoyXayRAHMkqFvKJzYSDKOJbyMVFhP81wn_hIY7hwVd8Xee4A9rUPsXVgUVuox-MCN5VTstAupme6TpMXiukvrYWUm-ey8___U7WiHCgJ1d18DI_H39nxe52xgxDcM_Ybjw_u9iJMzLkojTwpU-rrDAwesS3XoqHOS1s2JpoaaJWjT4-QIHosBo5p6vbNeI=).

*   **Heavy Seed Theory (Direct Collapse):** This theory suggests that much larger black holes, potentially up to a million solar masses, form directly from the collapse of massive gas clouds. This "direct collapse" could explain the existence of massive black holes in the early universe. Observations of the Infinity Galaxy have provided evidence supporting this, suggesting a black hole formed directly from a gas cloud within colliding galaxies [nasa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFBvM_B_6QZVqpB6mYVFfIRYoyXayRAHMkqFvKJzYSDKOJbyMVFhP81wn_hIY7hwVd8Xee4A9rUPsXVgUVuox-MCN5VTstAupme6TpMXiukvrYWUm-ey8___U7WiHCgJ1d18DI_H39nxe52xgxDcM_Ybjw_u9iJMzLkojTwpU-rrDAwesS3XoqHOS1s2JpoaaJWjT4-QIHosBo5p6vbNeI=), [wustl](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG9ZuObh0ntQqLSwNOAZcsTUoEtpw8bOqvxGBTMGX1o037BGzp_VCTm-f9iHhFNDqpdhFZdTiiYmHyjh9a-quxz_ysPzLfXoXTWN31f0niQq0bmOji4gHc_keQxJcppZc3DW83qUXfJW1cUDw==). The process requires metal-free gas and sufficient Lyman-Werner radiation to prevent fragmentation and star formation [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHzuZ35alw2NaIVPto4_Rw-gXkAnV_9vvqm-Kmku98vykBhXPKU4VqcTFBVBvpAdg_XclT4iBGvv-hvucT_aQl4-Van224dmpk3g8w7tdIry6yU9guIEReUysjoOJJgatfiMcymFNeK45NR2L5fhlU-G9o=), [astronomy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFpQtfSeC1UsvvG57Hu1dTCOQcpIUIU82Lc74S2p6-BOvJVI8jUHhRgV878jMnjqpTJnnCtdlVGzrUhgulyG_gV7bYfpsZ_kbsu5r5H26enKpC3b48yNRtqwa7IkTN_8rAQn__Aakrkiqatk3cxYVwMKZ4jcvQ_JlS9JGiWJMVa5pFFHDfRQ0EdzNWRqyGbtBeamjmxOePHi1rWWhgtnKR2zbmPoLtxQ72Y4QmLIg==). Simulations of this process are computationally intensive and aim to form massive black hole seeds ranging from 10⁴ to 10⁶ solar masses [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHzuZ35alw2NaIVPto4_Rw-gXkAnV_9vvqm-Kmku98vykBhXPKU4VqcTFBVBvpAdg_XclT4iBGvv-hvucT_aQl4-Van224dmpk3g8w7tdIry6yU9guIEReUysjoOJJgatfiMcymFNeK45NR2L5fhlU-G9o=). The galaxy UHZ1, with a black hole of approximately 40 million solar masses within a galaxy of about 100 million solar masses, provides strong support for this theory by exhibiting characteristics of an "Over-Massive Black Hole Galaxy" (OBG) [skyandtelescope](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFpQtfSeC1UsvvG57Hu1dTCOQcpIUIU82Lc74S2p6-BOvJVI8jUHhRgV878jMnjqpTJnnCtdlVGzrUhgulyG_gV7bYfpsZ_kbsu5r5H26enKpC3b48yNRtqwa7IkTN_8rAQn__Aakrkiqatk3cxYVwMKZ4jcvQ_JlS9JGiWJMVa5pFFHDfRQ0EdzNWRqyGbtBeamjmxOePHi1rWWhgtnKR2zbmPoLtxQ72Y4QmLIg==2).

*   **Primordial Black Holes (PBHs):** These are theoretical black holes that may have formed in the first fraction of a second after the Big Bang from density fluctuations in the early universe [theguardian](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFLrQaH2ULI13V_kpGVfCpy9kwjdxeyfa7ZwhKkBmoTxMnSRIWkneOS6TAP4BzJ8Vojodq1UaBdukkamT0cbCg6fXBV7MbgTZDhALmmBTiYh-0PUjsrOlissGYzQkG2kOpJWAplC7_9xhxAbZ4vvgZHWC7CqY1ovtnpSNbtH7e3JrPaYvWnbVAKo1ptWpDnQJVXveo45rMbHBCFzf7HaCTz6ci2kw==), [arxiv](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHCGcOn5O-wE_2rhOJckw7UcBYTQwWD4trbtOpW_YI7qu1eW9Uo4mS6kY5b3uD44guFbTfhPu7tJppyDSaKXgMjOmxoTuCeUe1eNwTsPqQqnj2ncssOKH7nP7vQ). PBHs can span a wide range of masses and may have acted as gravitational seeds for the first galaxies [theguardian](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFLrQaH2ULI13V_kpGVfCpy9kwjdxeyfa7ZwhKkBmoTxMnSRIWkneOS6TAP4BzJ8Vojodq1UaBdukkamT0cbCg6fXBV7MbgTZDhALmmBTiYh-0PUjsrOlissGYzQkG2kOpJWAplC7_9xhxAbZ4vvgZHWC7CqY1ovtnpSNbtH7e3JrPaYvWnbVAKo1ptWpDnQJVXveo45rMbHBCFzf7HaCTz6ci2kw==). The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has detected an ancient, "nearly naked" black hole dating back to the early universe, which, if confirmed as a PBH, would significantly alter cosmological theories [theguardian](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFLrQaH2ULI13V_kpGVfCpy9kwjdxeyfa7ZwhKkBmoTxMnSRIWkneOS6TAP4BzJ8Vojodq1UaBdukkamT0cbCg6fXBV7MbgTZDhALmmBTiYh-0PUjsrOlissGYzQkG2kOpJWAplC7_9xhxAbZ4vvgZHWC7CqY1ovtnpSNbtH7e3JrPaYvWnbVAKo1ptWpDnQJVXveo45rMbHBCFzf7HaCTz6ci2kw==). PBHs are also considered potential candidates for dark matter and could explain some gravitational wave events [deepfly](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGH_6LUfJpFujbjl0z2CvagrJljB_vVjCOgBkmHEH7IapaCImw3_KIcfKa-zN9SsIjXUAacvUqiAFkdPRB2kZjylIZqD-vAoEHSunuA4i6RClP6h2h2JXxgl2fkIznfi-dk7eBm6wcLk2tWFT4YJQcModg5C9fhio80JYwn56uvwoasV6cOKK9OLYeycNnL), [cern](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfn_aABPJAnW5gIYU6e584YPDUfjS3HZJ3vNoa8OXO03eAECW1mRGuwtZrfA2NXjvLmFFNM2X-hNu8yQqMkkexr7WTA-9QHXOXT0UjLL1WV8sIn-_5ehXzoy_yf83G5PgLfoVvcj4Atu1kWuBhJwfr5Hy8BWJ4MaTq-PIEzVsqg7WiUP552fgx_xcAThYjR_rgXelyY2064QVFdr_mH_0=). Simulations indicate that PBHs can embed in dense gas and grow, acting as effective seeds for supermassive black holes at high redshifts [theoj](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZq040wG_eE1T4absKOQTUXhtFDQx6ptJ57plJJw3_olEAq3uDesHC9wMqXZdvbucoDnmLN2E_Md0i3sn882cjKD8biS5D1vZeLq3FmdGnFg9-mkH_QNqBvYbL8C0SYG49XtmVIaU9emGWD8YUYyZzPUNT7DB_5FkJZV5tFDUzF-2Mmog1oKHC9drQFZG91ThpxG_1hXtTmb6_RXMoIviWw1-g_csM1BtWDc2gi4zc5WWx-MkuB954Uaoqhk1dHeyNiCk=).

*   **Dark Stars:** This is a more recent theoretical concept where hypothetical "dark stars" could have formed in regions with high dark matter density. Instead of nuclear fusion, they would be powered by the annihilation of dark matter particles. Over time, these massive dark stars could evolve into the seeds of supermassive black holes, potentially explaining their rapid formation in the early universe [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEe4lO5dyYuvGJpcp3dMh15zQ5eH3hdUwzKi1Z33sO1HLUtLns7GOlkIoOb-kDRhACT-4ym1liXeSd7yqsTFVaHPOosW2dcTiVxutbXhJmp6bGOEOvIpuu_sIqOHZlR1X317BJq2A8=), [scitechdaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFitnV1Gvi59vIrQzrf8oeQsULU2bKvJNzJAjMif8GQhVYBn0k64yXG98TDDcMQgfgVAZZC36u9tdTULB9p3dTQ2m34AqnegO317SMWVeYOJ6xQsb49-bNVC732vDTC3YLMaznFBR5H1vsmivH1l1wsxImBxhL-NAFxKyooWsOqYXGyrLBjkbJVEq-fSRzqv2JM). JWST observations have identified four extremely distant objects whose characteristics align with theoretical predictions for supermassive dark stars, showing potential absorption features of singly ionized helium [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHBSvqPKzX8dwUx-HghDriVKUZFBSIdVsKHOb8_yR8XQy1B5NDTob5HK6g0EzCNZ8MP6sCcWo2wxPVdliPpKiRwpKipkfGkn9VY58r7Bt5MOqKeJzjo0KWhm1twOJEQNwavA7KxmEJXEtMN2mCKNzdJnio0QHoxW3Ba).

**3. Other Theories and Developments:**
*   **Black Hole Evaporation:** Stephen Hawking's theory suggesting black holes can emit radiation and eventually disappear is still being explored [deepfly](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGH_6LUfJpFujbjl0z2CvagrJljB_vVjCOgBkmHEH7IapaCImw3_KIcfKa-zN9SsIjXUAacvUqiAFkdPRB2kZjylIZqD-vAoEHSunuA4i6RClP6h2h2JXxgl2fkIznfi-dk7eBm6wcLk2tWFT4YJQcModg5C9fhio80JYwn56uvwoasV6cOKK9OLYeycNnL).
*   **"Black Hole Universe" Model:** A theoretical model proposes that our universe may have originated from the gravitational collapse that formed a massive black hole within a larger parent universe [port](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG9ZuObh0ntQqLSwNOAZcsTUoEtpw8bOqvxGBTMGX1o037BGzp_VCTm-f9iHhFNDqpdhFZdTiiYmHyjh9a-quxz_ysPzLfXoXTWN31f0niQq0bmOji4gHc_keQxJcppZc3DW83qUXfJW1cUDw==2).
*   **Magnetic Field Influence:** New simulations suggest that magnetic fields play a crucial role in forming black holes that exceed known mass limits by ejecting material from collapsing stars [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG9ZuObh0ntQqLSwNOAZcsTUoEtpw8bOqvxGBTMGX1o037BGzp_VCTm-f9iHhFNDqpdhFZdTiiYmHyjh9a-quxz_ysPzLfXoXTWN31f0niQq0bmOji4gHc_keQxJcppZc3DW83qUXfJW1cUDw==3).

Recent observations from the JWST are providing unprecedented insights into the early universe, revealing rapidly growing supermassive black holes in nascent galaxies that challenge existing models [universetoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEDzqx-8xtH5klyccUMd3VdkvUrwhevnko8xs_PMBQE6wBOoRwbBQWw0tyV0lPYJrs6cFixqHfzmRiRYEANtKWDmUUmpL07VHpxnyhq73LYfuEuw1ea-7gP379ZVF02to-i-dn95wy9J3uYYyaaP5zWy0wrCVWTAhu0LUF55OMBu3snvZpuIv811A9X92n9wdV_k5KVGe6e_VWESkQxRf3c2PnfOOkJD-Y4a54b). Gravitational wave detections are also continuously refining our understanding of black hole formation and evolution across cosmic time [astronomy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHjdXqJbBKIxmRem9CN5pwXbxmGBWdB-v6wLEnAR8BUfuNewfEj5c4zyenUyqilfoI2NY2W0OV2J8scZrMZMYMDu_VF71wLW0LySsGJRlPngRjaRcs4IkIcxVb1DVawrhOlVSNIyIlIcFKsE9h8kFFbjXVIKco9hvQvH-2TlrFE38JcmhMOExxpA_nf1pmSDKbVZQ==).

**How Vaccines Trigger an Immune Response:**

1.  **Introducing Antigens:** Vaccines introduce an antigen into your body. An antigen is a substance that triggers an immune response. code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

The history of the internet is a narrative of scientific innovation, military foresight, and evolving technological capabilities, originating in the mid-20th century.

**Early Concepts and ARPANET:**
The seeds of the internet were sown in the late 1950s with J.C.R. code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

The main drivers of climate change are primarily human-induced greenhouse gas emissions, with recent findings indicating an acceleration of global warming due to several interconnected factors.

Key causes and contributing factors include:

*   **Greenhouse Gas Emissions:** The continued increase in atmospheric concentrations of carbon dioxide (CO2), methane, and nitrous oxide remains the principal driver of long-term warming. In 2025, global CO2 emissions reached a new all-time high, increasing by 1.1% compared to 2024 [carbonbrief](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFa7wnqrOdO0m_98cabPgEx2EuHUfoYloK9VNtpi19hmATe_V02GdJspS7bcmwKoVMQ65Q9BsTHvhZBA-t3ssOrcCB8dJqMkjwREcwdStrgBPTDA1eOf2bDzvhkn3hZl0eZbwK7Sg78vkrwIFJgejG-Kx_A9gMqobsfsBTieJwkr6j_4an36XGKmCp1Xct62lI1D2j4JoJZcLdpYnPWW6cfaRJpviYKtkoZRfo=) [berkeleyearth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG8xJ1VCBeT090Lne2Exa0JpF_dkexdhLB2X6MeKnwBYH6Gj7tA2WwWIjWviFSIFnJMDdMa8HwyyCjBUJBCfAZA_KHtYJkm0_r7tQGSc2nsYQwcpZkTUniQlqEYNPlCoci59ROMBk9RafZKqfxYmRhEumMikqgiGjw=) [joins](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFDoGDAwSy_S0hZ-btV1r3cyPKG5tHzhnQvIwMjEyuTVJteWAKhsLet-xUF9IDl2VWz9Ab-y04kVxb_0RCxxMPuSShg4M0JAeFYiK__4erj4dte7JCT8wqYfYvQVz61zi-s2khQEu1LggZgT1hkvjI=1) [berkeleyearth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFDoGDAwSy_S0hZ-btV1r3cyPKG5tHzhnQvIwMjEyuTVJteWAKhsLet-xUF9IDl2VWz9Ab-y04kVxb_0RCxxMPuSShg4M0JAeFYiK__4erj4dte7JCT8wqYfYvQVz61zi-s2khQEu1LggZgT1hkvjI=2). Burning fossil fuels for energy, transportation, and industry is the leading source of these emissions [climatecentral](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG6Fguw-UYTzl08alBnPM_cjYFQ9AqZs9_Ah3xkskQKOBexGKRAq7mZTOOZvsVB2DqYLTUnR3TQLvwi0sMvYXA9KwNr_BYaRfITKITR5hE3zk_oC8xA72bqL7RnMAyZ8MVXiqwoUiljwYNix2jbeeQNKFalNddA0BcsSvcbVgrjpjefsq1rNRHxBMlhYQ==).
*   **Declining Aerosol Emissions:** Reductions in anthropogenic aerosol emissions, particularly sulfate aerosols from burning fossil fuels and shipping, have intensified warming since 2010 [azocleantech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEuUUIveVxhIfccALobeewTi-yrlatB1w10xokEUj9Q3IxA5IwcurBV-bKtoQ6ZEOYH67nhoQIDkT2r1ZrI3gFGk893QRuypRI3BE1C8snJYxKxM5KHzqoo_lA3yvN4NieyO0hQThN8VS-PsiZkBvXAgZmx) [ncas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFoM3XfOzDszstN3GymLT84vXuVmEIw6fPnOvciO3zI7z7LvkbB1I9rsRoapoQt75Frksw64RSOO-Ck9fb_UlMvs6Mbzy2VOpt2BcvcA_BlzHgPXk6ebdcfFiQMPQ7WxiU2VI3tsaIZfGgMObxeulwmF-RKxj4jaN93uNvjAg5cC3rduHYWdYNRQQbVH16JHAVMvRtW-VGMBr8e1tL9eg==). Aerosols previously had a cooling effect by reflecting sunlight, and their decrease has diminished this "hidden cooling effect," leading to faster surface warming [skepticalscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHdjLYD4r5z5Z49RMh3HoMFiq_HwIg6FlbCGb8Q9YTXZ6isEDc_mAVLyKqXNCw2kfS3YbR1NmStqYrTIOnh2kRxMS6Yqkw1C4fXlALgKaJ3jDW0_Ktd-tD9kmljoCG7WGfXLA1KCp-iVpth8oRI2BlAFPQJg-CCpP0=) [skepticalscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAFTbwxRCTHf6TvH4oCoe4ezekNde_GpIxzMlV4O95N3JlfzgMiWroI1T0zQxbYpjVXHYDQKKoBUUIgLD-yHS1uu2jX7G6nu9s9MuKS1x7733DCGhpRdpvYYotQZJF16HDGllPJUdn0hWceTDTJsAfYRT3q0UMYop8ebJB).

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

kwargs.question: Explain the theory of relativity in simple terms.

output:
Einstein's theory of relativity is a profound framework that fundamentally changed our understanding of space, time, gravity, and the universe. It is comprised of two interconnected theories: **special relativity** and **general relativity** [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHEaSPwP6X93XjxdtEVBlpZ5DNCZ2cVJVRKqjeBe9rCjwfaRHBNCDDNiOw7o01i9sVEbfG0W1Lm_XI6-_a0KNu06I-K9dtnqzCsMNYkwe8wl_77mC2F-Jb2hWLylbp_pn9g8TZEeM_I4XaodnV-) [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI).

### Special Relativity

Special relativity, introduced in 1905, deals with the relationship between space, time, mass, and energy when gravity is not a factor [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHJ_iBRj8zmgb7sTNPIFGmQqS-AhLIKMx6UtzO1M2y4uFIQE8AcVrEG0TbkpL83ojx-zaH827RtaV8LA5OslwPzXzK9jisNhpRBQBUy41g2ICWl-nVabQahOSKBr6qTg21zw-YLaCoxe9zIs2SQyhJ4loYaQvo=) [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI). It is built on two core principles:

*   **The Principle of Relativity:** The laws of physics are the same for all observers moving at a constant speed and direction [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG9Fm9H4I-auW-_FfSbvcBhoHPomjEyS3SN8S3mGwh4Y6ugG7AgwT4hJcx8Ywk7jNURfTyDw6bZLv8iy7UOknlfQPBjcKDrRXxa_Av1AT0dVW7huzaRz9yDkEOAfEtDXbP75c6vR2DlUmTYWQ==) [dummies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHtzw9q4SNKCCve2ncNMzJPRFxrp7PYrnGaipoEsu-dQeBarmFxKNNxB-Z0Uy718jqjX35lUcFhRk7NXPJCFACYqO0TYvSuY8cejaJn4dv_PUwD8EWHPYurEkdj0FvvxW0Iw9d1oscFtaNolVxEtpRP7TyCBFULgnmcbWvj8bHpWw7bJxDDXKagtEFDZIHauoYnLcxYospH5NLll-P0G27XcBg=).
*   **The Principle of the Speed of Light:** The speed of light in a vacuum is constant for everyone, regardless of how fast they are moving or how fast the light source is moving [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG9Fm9H4I-auW-_FfSbvcBhoHPomjEyS3SN8S3mGwh4Y6ugG7AgwT4hJcx8Ywk7jNURfTyDw6bZLv8iy7UOknlfQPBjcKDrRXxa_Av1AT0dVW7huzaRz9yDkEOAfEtDXbP75c6vR2DlUmTYWQ==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF94Xb3_gfkg5dTq2ImOFvz-yUqVrfd7GC_rGzer3ioQxzoTiVnY-LlSuex-MG4lzOBK1BwPD0H3iAK-izubojzdFDBohwhJeM5l-9F_rpi2_kbeT2qOLlMt16BkNKpU_Dick6f3AA=). This speed is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second (c) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF94Xb3_gfkg5dTq2ImOFvz-yUqVrfd7GC_rGzer3ioQxzoTiVnY-LlSuex-MG4lzOBK1BwPD0H3iAK-izubojzdFDBohwhJeM5l-9F_rpi2_kbeT2qOLlMt16BkNKpU_Dick6f3AA=).

A crucial outcome of these principles is that space and time are not separate, absolute entities but are interwoven into a single fabric called **spacetime** [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFiLHD1ZyePCn-9CNpdfOMCHNPdhE1ks9zGN1s-E1K7uixFgvIihMn_NE_ivztSnQjGlWsGyGhz50ZFgvlAAmxVLvyCIRt28mMK5s165hauvMu01czlD_0p018bfNRNcfw4cu34RlE=) [dummies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHtzw9q4SNKCCve2ncNMzJPRFxrp7PYrnGaipoEsu-dQeBarmFxKNNxB-Z0Uy718jqjX35lUcFhRk7NXPJCFACYqO0TYvSuY8cejaJn4dv_PUwD8EWHPYurEkdj0FvvxW0Iw9d1oscFtaNolVxEtpRP7TyCBFULgnmcbWvj8bHpWw7bJxDDXKagtEFDZIHauoYnLcxYospH5NLll-P0G27XcBg=). As objects approach the speed of light, our measurements of time and distance become relative to our own movement [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF94Xb3_gfkg5dTq2ImOFvz-yUqVrfd7GC_rGzer3ioQxzoTiVnY-LlSuex-MG4lzOBK1BwPD0H3iAK-izubojzdFDBohwhJeM5l-9F_rpi2_kbeT2qOLlMt16BkNKpU_Dick6f3AA=). This leads to phenomena like **time dilation**, where time slows down for a moving object compared to a stationary one [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHJ_iBRj8zmgb7sTNPIFGmQqS-AhLIKMx6UtzO1M2y4uFIQE8AcVrEG0TbkpL83ojx-zaH827RtaV8LA5OslwPzXzK9jisNhpRBQBUy41g2ICWl-nVabQahOSKBr6qTg21zw-YLaCoxe9zIs2SQyhJ4loYaQvo=) [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI). Another famous consequence is the equivalence of mass and energy, expressed by the iconic equation **E=mc²**, meaning mass and energy can be converted into each other [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHJ_iBRj8zmgb7sTNPIFGmQqS-AhLIKMx6UtzO1M2y4uFIQE8AcVrEG0TbkpL83ojx-zaH827RtaV8LA5OslwPzXzK9jisNhpRBQBUy41g2ICWl-nVabQahOSKBr6qTg21zw-YLaCoxe9zIs2SQyhJ4loYaQvo=) [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI). Special relativity also states that nothing can travel faster than light.

### General Relativity

General relativity, proposed in 1915, expands upon special relativity by incorporating gravity. Einstein's theory of gravity suggests that gravity isn't a force but rather a result of **spacetime being curved** by mass and energy [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4T7boxLq8FWjJSxHinyTfi6247n_grFSS-_Phbj9aEa8Es4bKecPLOCpnRG8mEsrK1b3T87Mc3ALzC5PSDw6-rnZsxDCOUcUaxsfZx-pJ4TZ3oGNlTnx7qw5F-RA9DbVZS6M6R1D4fd3dcLBOfXGRUfJcLOk=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGH9zJZxwdVuweZlxJFeWpFql5WvB7KLjJk7cv2TDl7q1vd62R9DHsWBT-Dzu5LFVMgB2r0HH0S8k18pGmmgkHeI9sVR_bC1VdHqPMn36APwj599oobFhBRzlRAqtEQseoL0vTDHdAIgDeJaw==). Massive objects warp the fabric of spacetime around them, and this distortion is what we perceive as gravity [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFiLHD1ZyePCn-9CNpdfOMCHNPdhE1ks9zGN1s-E1K7uixFgvIihMn_NE_ivztSnQjGlWsGyGhz50ZFgvlAAmxVLvyCIRt28mMK5s165hauvMu01czlD_0p018bfNRNcfw4cu34RlE=) [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI).

Key phenomena explained by general relativity include:

*   **Gravitational Lensing:** Light bends as it passes by massive objects, acting like a lens that can distort or magnify the light from objects behind them [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4T7boxLq8FWjJSxHinyTfi6247n_grFSS-_Phbj9aEa8Es4bKecPLOCpnRG8mEsrK1b3T87Mc3ALzC5PSDw6-rnZsxDCOUcUaxsfZx-pJ4TZ3oGNlTnx7qw5F-RA9DbVZS6M6R1D4fd3dcLBOfXGRUfJcLOk=).
*   **Changes in Mercury's Orbit:** General relativity accurately explains the slight anomalies in Mercury's orbit that Newtonian physics couldn't account for [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4T7boxLq8FWjJSxHinyTfi6247n_grFSS-_Phbj9aEa8Es4bKecPLOCpnRG8mEsrK1b3T87Mc3ALzC5PSDw6-rnZsxDCOUcUaxsfZx-pJ4TZ3oGNlTnx7qw5F-RA9DbVZS6M6R1D4fd3dcLBOfXGRUfJcLOk=).
*   **Gravitational Waves:** These are ripples in spacetime generated by massive accelerating objects, such as colliding black holes [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4T7boxLq8FWjJSxHinyTfi6247n_grFSS-_Phbj9aEa8Es4bKecPLOCpnRG8mEsrK1b3T87Mc3ALzC5PSDw6-rnZsxDCOUcUaxsfZx-pJ4TZ3oGNlTnx7qw5F-RA9DbVZS6M6R1D4fd3dcLBOfXGRUfJcLOk=).
*   **Gravitational Time Dilation:** Time passes more slowly in areas with stronger gravitational fields. This effect is even factored into GPS satellite systems for accuracy [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETsJ--vGNtmehjF_K0bGCvKv8mq4ZsKUIq5MBYcBzmSFjTrU1uDnZsudfSrp3d1WUkphkbCYWOtDIhDnT25n6uSBRXCCpf2J1fyuBjo9oaAVWN7YDGiQ5IfgrydSqt0XT88lt9idLF64OJBZRAxJgI0) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGH9zJZxwdVuweZlxJFeWpFql5WvB7KLjJk7cv2TDl7q1vd62R9DHsWBT-Dzu5LFVMgB2r0HH0S8k18pGmmgkHeI9sVR_bC1VdHqPMn36APwj599oobFhBRzlRAqtEQseoL0vTDHdAIgDeJaw==).

General relativity has been extensively tested and validated. However, its predictions are expected to break down at the quantum level, and unifying it with quantum mechanics remains a major challenge in physics [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHJ_iBRj8zmgb7sTNPIFGmQqS-AhLIKMx6UtzO1M2y4uFIQE8AcVrEG0TbkpL83ojx-zaH827RtaV8LA5OslwPzXzK9jisNhpRBQBUy41g2ICWl-nVabQahOSKBr6qTg21zw-YLaCoxe9zIs2SQyhJ4loYaQvo=).

kwargs.question: What is quantum computing and how does it differ from classical computing?

output:
Quantum computing represents a paradigm shift in information processing, diverging significantly from the way classical computers operate. At its core, quantum computing leverages the principles of quantum mechanics to perform computations in novel ways [techtimes](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2P8797i8RwM_g1uEd0Zg0BQeyD9Bze_6qWXeU5ioWEgQyua6lVXpeHLfDJOQt4uQ9C1mIsfpvDg4SCqDyeKteKXFbgU9lKmSZ0gItPIllxLAD2aMt9eDwb6wPm28-D25e7ed1GXFA98GavKyAsXVE05TUW4HzWgU7_KabrF-YL4xeu7dMVEmvCHvZwuvTtKYZoE6hQTWPQmxUgbl3lJbXRXgJZCFyeLM4TYHL3UeEzqQMXGk__ZaZiJnESrc=), whereas classical computers rely on the established laws of classical physics [quantropi](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGGSuF0ZyyE3LmQ0WHA4AET9uIuXw_gMKXU4_jtYpmqkn84NsJGuxHQ8-3i2nHlOlsHVf0E9_3J8SLRSSREfuwhi-ECtQalcaqwsXkl6rqMUP53MGPjneRAiDhdM3aSMDYc7_xqY7zxHkYVYlAIXjYH50sV6-w796dG7fjnq7ngd-PqC0gkaGoBEHBLNDPtAQ==).

The fundamental difference lies in how data is represented and processed. Classical computers use bits, which can exist in one of two states: 0 or 1 [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG41z6h6uLirFf6t0XoUsmc32h5w2MYwCDpQPvauNVepjcLeLjjpgN5pfRoBfaM24bnMW8ttTheldc7rFjO-qhAO9CSQJvw_famTjd_tl93Ys6BtIbmmJ7diIA2EHjcnjdPkHpXaI63C67wxgrsU8pM5HT_hNBMfrHaDHmEDIGFWuqY3WdBpM2A0C_7PrVTgoaFiHnKMo-3Fvp4MPIvB78F8Ak=) [timesmicrowave](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFzOGzm4rUJNFHWzk5GchbNfPSVw10R_-srUU1vpA2LRV8lfx6_4a9qvkS60Y8fPNSaADSwNIjZGSBa83Dfs-P8cmIhSZM7WS-MGilVdtyZvBivzpI10pfLfw9shdaoBbJdXucVNmMRJUsvZhQ5y3j8q7oN5enltDBMvxtn-iURh9_KBgE08Ln4CrjXZDk=). In contrast, quantum computers utilize quantum bits, or qubits. Qubits benefit from quantum phenomena such as superposition, allowing them to exist in multiple states simultaneously (both 0 and 1 at once) [quantropi](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGGSuF0ZyyE3LmQ0WHA4AET9uIuXw_gMKXU4_jtYpmqkn84NsJGuxHQ8-3i2nHlOlsHVf0E9_3J8SLRSSREfuwhi-ECtQalcaqwsXkl6rqMUP53MGPjneRAiDhdM3aSMDYc7_xqY7zxHkYVYlAIXjYH50sV6-w796dG7fjnq7ngd-PqC0gkaGoBEHBLNDPtAQ==) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG41z6h6uLirFf6t0XoUsmc32h5w2MYwCDpQPvauNVepjcLeLjjpgN5pfRoBfaM24bnMW8ttTheldc7rFjO-qhAO9CSQJvw_famTjd_tl93Ys6BtIbmmJ7diIA2EHjcnjdPkHpXaI63C67wxgrsU8pM5HT_hNBMfrHaDHmEDIGFWuqY3WdBpM2A0C_7PrVTgoaFiHnKMo-3Fvp4MPIvB78F8Ak=) [spinquanta](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG5ehK51JTr2DL9YKtdBAJN76475N8bAboSTHz0wR09XdD1x8OisN861JFvHSFHKgy1JSrg2whIV1zCWyV0hR5RJfe-0VXy49XSV6qK_8IFXfgkDGJ6vhXwKuLDXx5pTDp4K8SCXjRW1j6KEK575fZ4_3uVL5FFmpidO1CKt4ocJ2z6-hteqO3cyEiy32L9D40HSt9f6iZc71E=). code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

kwargs.question: Explain how memory works in computers.

output:
Computer memory is essential for a computer's operation, acting as a temporary storage space for data and instructions that the Central Processing Unit (CPU) needs for immediate processing. This memory is organized hierarchically, balancing speed, capacity, and cost to optimize performance [unstop](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_2RykBsYmXQP9Gh7O-4ECnT2Qqy885thjXJX3wjF3hN93ufqzSXhSAeQHBG0wiM0DA5mDfOH7AEOOt7LFHiBYpvvkfq4hVi61pG9YyLhOZ0GuwTetx_pxtChjncAq6zQydQatkH1A0HfhWOsxw4BNeAhJ4XuqLzZumsap) [tutorchase](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHtPnj-LM_Bed62rze8qw_tmMTVIoxOTPtd03pntXLOBcHBCwmTprHavnH8pI8WmWNKlGaVBbpSb1gOgIiFzU41BTVN_VxmGidQLgIpn9qTqyVP9Uy6w6TDKWXK_hrY4JQB-dxe2pFZSITfuUx3O59UuoOfoRcFjPdIvo2IdIoEkrCIU-XtnuKUjEdvabqEvo_WKH13AfMScbkttWmL-xXDyPqjj7lDpOPSZY_F68dkGg==).

The primary types of memory involved in this process are:

*   **Registers:** Located directly within the CPU, registers are the smallest and fastest memory units. They hold data and instructions that the CPU is actively using, allowing for near-instantaneous access. However, their capacity is extremely limited, typically measured in bytes [phoenixnap](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGgRn2eyg411SOLciSLO_iuJIeNnwp073pMZoByIkZoEQlZxzh7fOjt-4ivh3Orcxh185pjuGw45u9vkVeM0GFfpJ3EULhDyNOWcsar3q6cfdTFzbJALo_fvjDtSz4vYtzhodlQSQ==) [massedcompute](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEIsrRm3IAyxe3hqLv-1XPJjOI-1EsadNZi6lNlnZwrKFBY8NdUhnX-r-lNOpSNMQ1WJzrzxw9f2YPvDSNRkkNYL_kyI-S9rXmd4IlJ1ETGk-GTol5oaJQXsJ4RX4HL8buuVnyOifS1D_7AZ6S3tQKbo1KstcETHDaKl6IAg83dtV9CENyxmJKDs-eZtnXiA84xVfAQDWPJkco_ndiqvGCdDEW0A2U3SBlsXq-ZFkqNB4nbC7xmtSDd0gnG6mr_QVqDcZ9nZW8=) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHCrT10N2rEOWkFOQgH4w8jj1RIr-meKflLEV-zK7nzEaWFgU36_pMMjUpqACityALMnDM_m8sSn3f0PEIzrJN3CIRTlNKqyDlQWHnACFMUqRugEomNzk5QfYl_n7rcXjtFREY-dQmc0lnopQesTuBrfhchaJOb-EyrfqB6iXUGUA8zb1LOyljRxROvQHhxndladd2Y2ayKEAH0vyO0TbI_UGBXirW_IDva).

*   **Cache Memory:** Cache serves as a high-speed buffer situated between the CPU and RAM. Its purpose is to store frequently accessed data and instructions, significantly reducing the time the CPU spends retrieving information from the slower main memory [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG3kD-uoiojpmDS9bmkU0I-k8S1j4kHCqaZHDEqZVJTw2PRqQ_xUKfXhohVKKbhS9ZfUAZ9Gq4963qxqQ-Y1cmL7WVK6qi792u3g5uLK1C5QUabDv-IfjOYr8ySnZ3iJoSDzyD2E6_Ikk_o1tlfsiFK_FPmLDlR3p_TPQg=) [nationin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGdyK6Ttk-DqLVur_PcYKmx3neJRkSdJGWb6PCciT_CAuzMAtDPruNKCYizmKnup4WkV4vE2w-88OVbtfSURvEsyQ5spStG5vbeOdrzG6AJ79LZpRUj7EQkJqkwmdM5QCJa2lzMvMt1PF9WsZmbSX5lrTGNw5W9fo__KMuvBCFGjp6-4nvZb2itFqzY7TPOON7pCQFNeM1x5ZksPxo=) [phoenixnap](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGgRn2eyg411SOLciSLO_iuJIeNnwp073pMZoByIkZoEQlZxzh7fOjt-4ivh3Orcxh185pjuGw45u9vkVeM0GFfpJ3EULhDyNOWcsar3q6cfdTFzbJALo_fvjDtSz4vYtzhodlQSQ==). Cache is organized into multiple levels (L1, L2, and L3), with L1 being the smallest, fastest, and closest to the CPU core, while L3 is the largest and slowest of the cache levels, shared among all CPU cores [pikuma](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGnnYoGBFGKmRMUodZIJxP8QdayVmsIlV0fF4qD6MhKUm1xqJDKD1IEoeXg9x24CoPrJ9GkJQlB52FyodSiAERAuPdE95vAtOsEZrT8D-Jsy81Qpx9oGqMlsEWEp8QPBy8RfOcFQ5vML1ErUe49ff8=) [abhik](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuqiYCM8_TqQOrp5AsqBz6-JaRXpKZYayMO9KSDaHwlZWjiELgHuKJ_dU54uQvn4V1qfZpEWQwpxvvOK1pHcaGrVX5Ojp5oZujl1_xW1-tr49MTPwInlz9hV1_LRCiYuNzlsRA3DCrX5EN8YVj) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuqiYCM8_TqQOrp5AsqBz6-JaRXpKZYayMO9KSDaHwlZWjiELgHuKJ_dU54uQvn4V1qfZpEWQwpxvvOK1pHcaGrVX5Ojp5oZujl1_xW1-tr49MTPwInlz9hV1_LRCiYuNzlsRA3DCrX5EN8YVj0). Due to its speed and proximity to the CPU, cache memory is more expensive per unit than RAM and has a much smaller capacity, usually measured in kilobytes or megabytes [hp](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGVZNn-qMskfYh_9nzsr5nMyxHxdABZrWRrOsYnvo7eRwhqiaQRyMokh_jikUZ4Pdj2RMUOmRxjcRK8QaIxVsZ2ouk5kbU0gdBQl_sOlZ77JEBj3EEHC1t-U1fpIXGWc7TKph-wN3dSFRYtQofRCcpQp4EWWswZrhA=) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG3kD-uoiojpmDS9bmkU0I-k8S1j4kHCqaZHDEqZVJTw2PRqQ_xUKfXhohVKKbhS9ZfUAZ9Gq4963qxqQ-Y1cmL7WVK6qi792u3g5uLK1C5QUabDv-IfjOYr8ySnZ3iJoSDzyD2E6_Ikk_o1tlfsiFK_FPmLDlR3p_TPQg=) [nationin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGdyK6Ttk-DqLVur_PcYKmx3neJRkSdJGWb6PCciT_CAuzMAtDPruNKCYizmKnup4WkV4vE2w-88OVbtfSURvEsyQ5spStG5vbeOdrzG6AJ79LZpRUj7EQkJqkwmdM5QCJa2lzMvMt1PF9WsZmbSX5lrTGNw5W9fo__KMuvBCFGjp6-4nvZb2itFqzY7TPOON7pCQFNeM1x5ZksPxo=).

*   **Random Access Memory (RAM):** RAM is the computer's main working memory. It stores the operating system, applications, and data that are currently in use, allowing the CPU to access them quickly [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEfsMJsalRo0Qv9rOXTnqfKLsXEtYzhIzNjHboUtcO6mYBBqs5iUAmILnjItEIPRBRIisq-B_7ZmccfPcGnBqaQzRkdsDZHkwG8sXEn0988ItOi9_Z8Zc0890gTmN_Xaw0w7CHg4Anuu10MfjMYY2RrrNIztNB1z1ZpQJSsJBRiEuSDTsIdXyH7TYqxHFykMynXCRsuFrIAZ6b8MuNQ) [abhik](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuqiYCM8_TqQOrp5AsqBz6-JaRXpKZYayMO9KSDaHwlZWjiELgHuKJ_dU54uQvn4V1qfZpEWQwpxvvOK1pHcaGrVX5Ojp5oZujl1_xW1-tr49MTPwInlz9hV1_LRCiYuNzlsRA3DCrX5EN8YVj) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGrtMZUOZ_lGwURsdgDT21JfGPn0fMygHacSNy_-qkpX0U-tSBA3EkCsjtqCYNo0xI0vA6jtTv3oBnuplQIpa3iFUQZiu9j6FKz3VYWtJxIqUPomGg_xYCbJLyGzzmDVGufqVV6HCk=) [phoenixnap](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGgRn2eyg411SOLciSLO_iuJIeNnwp073pMZoByIkZoEQlZxzh7fOjt-4ivh3Orcxh185pjuGw45u9vkVeM0GFfpJ3EULhDyNOWcsar3q6cfdTFzbJALo_fvjDtSz4vYtzhodlQSQ==) [patsnap](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHsFHUYoojZ4uyNPRnBFWYzfRtqagTZv53hUHVzmIIasORTSX-OvtoWOMrL6BCtNGgjqcxOIjmZmXF5ZH1zl_3vxFq5oew_Py2DzqL6-z71f_RWokApMsF-J37CdKfudwOKmHiDAx7vSFr6DkGFwVR_9qIdOcQjLn7c_WC8PsdudSe5GI74bNRxwpu6xEBPcsCf4YXj2fo=). RAM is volatile, meaning it loses its data when the power is turned off [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEfsMJsalRo0Qv9rOXTnqfKLsXEtYzhIzNjHboUtcO6mYBBqs5iUAmILnjItEIPRBRIisq-B_7ZmccfPcGnBqaQzRkdsDZHkwG8sXEn0988ItOi9_Z8Zc0890gTmN_Xaw0w7CHg4Anuu10MfjMYY2RrrNIztNB1z1ZpQJSsJBRiEuSDTsIdXyH7TYqxHFykMynXCRsuFrIAZ6b8MuNQ) [abhik](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuqiYCM8_TqQOrp5AsqBz6-JaRXpKZYayMO9KSDaHwlZWjiELgHuKJ_dU54uQvn4V1qfZpEWQwpxvvOK1pHcaGrVX5Ojp5oZujl1_xW1-tr49MTPwInlz9hV1_LRCiYuNzlsRA3DCrX5EN8YVj) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGrtMZUOZ_lGwURsdgDT21JfGPn0fMygHacSNy_-qkpX0U-tSBA3EkCsjtqCYNo0xI0vA6jtTv3oBnuplQIpa3iFUQZiu9j6FKz3VYWtJxIqUPomGg_xYCbJLyGzzmDVGufqVV6HCk=) [reddit](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEqmvRAvDjOBII1cI0pOUiQ4isc5YOiEFAtQSbOOz7dG11s5FPahHgwVKMNkPTYwOVO82zcfPYrSzQLLDeeI58gnxXRaR03IKgylFqEprmGY2oqBUnAZ85lLtiVJ0Je1oZ70cFV6G2gCKRI_fDUyDQtdq_PO_qUG98uiaJ3atQhcG9F-7wBNPH3fN7rL52NSNL1dd9gtLoD1aCwiXkLULH4aLuGx8sUwps=) [patsnap](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE4UzLnUi66PKuA2TPPhhMAZ6wNON-tiDbkz6CK1WZbsYyU_onDGOg2PsFoHTCC0XTU1qq2gszuKYgYSgOm14RUeyPncs5hVervAgAxGQR2Ug-Vb843ZsEIyhf9na8opFVoOgOboTI1LcGD1jgHG4spKKSZrDHzSy0VW4-vzIqqsuhylkPScXE727f1oGNR9gBeGkrAvZv-05v3u_okzw==). Modern computers typically have gigabytes of RAM, which enables multitasking and the smooth operation of complex applications [abhik](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGuqiYCM8_TqQOrp5AsqBz6-JaRXpKZYayMO9KSDaHwlZWjiELgHuKJ_dU54uQvn4V1qfZpEWQwpxvvOK1pHcaGrVX5Ojp5oZujl1_xW1-tr49MTPwInlz9hV1_LRCiYuNzlsRA3DCrX5EN8YVj) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGrtMZUOZ_lGwURsdgDT21JfGPn0fMygHacSNy_-qkpX0U-tSBA3EkCsjtqCYNo0xI0vA6jtTv3oBnuplQIpa3iFUQZiu9j6FKz3VYWtJxIqUPomGg_xYCbJLyGzzmDVGufqVV6HCk=) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF5rjaJw0LIHwYrul7dq_Eovc_Mbrb04Y7wOcrJV1WUNdFqqQB9alcZ7EhTpJcXM4DfH4CjzvDZIb3C6T9sxxJ5thg6VWrEeuDRXThpV3ge29KH80dxMNdpe-TYurlVR6OD5RLIQi4=). RAM allows the CPU to access any memory location directly, without sequential access [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEfsMJsalRo0Qv9rOXTnqfKLsXEtYzhIzNjHboUtcO6mYBBqs5iUAmILnjItEIPRBRIisq-B_7ZmccfPcGnBqaQzRkdsDZHkwG8sXEn0988ItOi9_Z8Zc0890gTmN_Xaw0w7CHg4Anuu10MfjMYY2RrrNIztNB1z1ZpQJSsJBRiEuSDTsIdXyH7TYqxHFykMynXCRsuFrIAZ6b8MuNQ).

**How They Work Together:**

The CPU first checks the cache memory for the required data. If the data is found (a "cache hit"), it is retrieved very quickly. If the data is not in the cache (a "cache miss"), the CPU then accesses RAM to retrieve it. A copy of this data is often stored in the cache for future use, optimizing performance by keeping frequently used data readily available [hp](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGVZNn-qMskfYh_9nzsr5nMyxHxdABZrWRrOsYnvo7eRwhqiaQRyMokh_jikUZ4Pdj2RMUOmRxjcRK8QaIxVsZ2ouk5kbU0gdBQl_sOlZ77JEBj3EEHC1t-U1fpIXGWc7TKph-wN3dSFRYtQofRCcpQp4EWWswZrhA=) [nationin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGdyK6Ttk-DqLVur_PcYKmx3neJRkSdJGWb6PCciT_CAuzMAtDPruNKCYizmKnup4WkV4vE2w-88OVbtfSURvEsyQ5spStG5vbeOdrzG6AJ79LZpRUj7EQkJqkwmdM5QCJa2lzMvMt1PF9WsZmbSX5lrTGNw5W9fo__KMuvBCFGjp6-4nvZb2itFqzY7TPOON7pCQFNeM1x5ZksPxo=). code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""
