*   **Display/Indicator:** Presents the processed information in a way that humans can understand [cadence](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGlkVluGZLQcvBr3PJTTP6wUjqTYOFDM9ygsrnwpkRrmJGAaxWE7PMXgOYDKRWYJVleJ5UwmKtouY85ju8uxGFCwnkk0T8N0D2JbbCm33StznWGTCyhYy7O3XHRzU52IhB3gNAcxKvLJWpMwX-yOyZOWSN4khMdn2KMy7N2caSoLzyM6Zvbir3zA6X4PmqdEF4zYbiQbQ==) [jetir](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHKBEUUulxVGkzhU50PZP-udsSNEpWPncbcH0v6GmTJIYrQyvyCvmQJGfW41nmE_VOwbK-GYiEscFwmHdOsiN-djByIozoemGuP08uOPwWtsSNI2jFlCXRxfjDomFDrmF7kqzfMYfVeLw==).
*   **Control and Processing Unit:** Oversees the overall operation of the radar system [cadence](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGlkVluGZLQcvBr3PJTTP6wUjqTYOFDM9ygsrnwpkRrmJGAaxWE7PMXgOYDKRWYJVleJ5UwmKtouY85ju8uxGFCwnkk0T8N0D2JbbCm33StznWGTCyhYy7O3XHRzU52IhB3gNAcxKvLJWpMwX-yOyZOWSN4khMdn2KMy7N2caSoLzyM6Zvbir3zA6X4PmqdEF4zYbiQbQ==) [jetir](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHKBEUUulxVGkzhU50PZP-udsSNEpWPncbcH0v6GmTJIYrQyvyCvmQJGfW41nmE_VOwbK-GYiEscFwmHdOsiN-djByIozoemGuP08uOPwWtsSNI2jFlCXRxfjDomFDrmF7kqzfMYfVeLw==).
*   **Power Supply:** Provides the necessary electrical power to all components [jetir](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHKBEUUulxVGkzhU50PZP-udsSNEpWPncbcH0v6GmTJIYrQyvyCvmQJGfW41nmE_VOwbK-GYiEscFwmHdOsiN-djByIozoemGuP08uOPwWtsSNI2jFlCXRxfjDomFDrmF7kqzfMYfVeLw==).

The process of how radar works involves several stages:
1.  **Transmission:** The radar system emits radio waves in pulses from its transmitter [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=) [noaa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGpUyzNw8E4thIEHI-QS2xV80Sho8mw5vXNs5dJkboeFtlPmnIL-rQJeQOxrZIA_dReIug7NXrvOatu9kT7YW5OeQGKbO0Cj_zNobFX8Btj23DFlKXZibu7LhwuUjOg3WVa57evPJ8ubiPhe6ybAvdEvg==) [oreateai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGq0K8ewB8-fTXzqMdU2Ge3UN5aCc15Nc-C-9IMn8n7qpFneE6eM2-EdfcBtmcT675W530ulff6_53M8qLAtLs0CSDZcF6LA2qFbovkqqmW2Mj6DkgmbTr8jcxUopvwAyLZstrvNCIE3Xk7ouC6eSbxkg-nZkDrnL-M_K4oDP0i-bjt5Zd_etXIPztfsNJwdovx4wPTeFNfXm66UPXUpevXuaYZKxNCtrEVU-fqM-bgLGL5O020UaHhUizGIbFXSSUaarldhx0IzCZYBB-M9LEeUwdkwJgKgtLbg==). These waves travel at the speed of light [oreateai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGq0K8ewB8-fTXzqMdU2Ge3UN5aCc15Nc-C-9IMn8n7qpFneE6eM2-EdfcBtmcT675W530ulff6_53M8qLAtLs0CSDZcF6LA2qFbovkqqmW2Mj6DkgmbTr8jcxUopvwAyLZstrvNCIE3Xk7ouC6eSbxkg-nZkDrnL-M_K4oDP0i-bjt5Zd_etXIPztfsNJwdovx4wPTeFNfXm66UPXUpevXuaYZKxNCtrEVU-fqM-bgLGL5O020UaHhUizGIbFXSSUaarldhx0IzCZYBB-M9LEeUwdkwJgKgtLbg==).
2.  **Reflection:** When these waves encounter an object, they are reflected back towards the radar [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=) [spotterglobal](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFxJAIAtatGRy0p5aqWCatba0I_0a-_y4A2aHm_7aJ7t_-JC27EiOlCQtZ5oScFaGVCztlpWzkqOGtoCHtWWbXLMV40wmV3nAO_znwfz6N0_NdNUCMOn1nHYh9rtit7ymMDHZU3iVvZWCYrxsx3sBKoLR1Aae_v6TaOxfLGsFKDG8Nocwu9VTxyXlc_qc0KhDUOLLzPPaUQdn2qQ92MZm59GdrwdMgXO5xSTEPXpwzinKDqUs2ey5LtGIlVxuiFngli1tc=) [radartutorial](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZcQ3mkYWEdFCa4kBzaFloHvTq9Zlwxs9w92kxl1LnqHIRhcRiRa7V1NaVKXm5FBV7_BL8F9jqezuLvYQFOHzzKYqC6__U41ouc2p8wDqOGicg1oA6bYJ7mQgPsZ8AihFtYi5moipvjWqQ7OiNh9dw0MIbvSwTJEadx9Q=). The way the waves reflect can provide information about the object's material and shape [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=).
3.  **Reception:** The radar's receiver captures these returning echoes [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=) [noaa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGpUyzNw8E4thIEHI-QS2xV80Sho8mw5vXNs5dJkboeFtlPmnIL-rQJeQOxrZIA_dReIug7NXrvOatu9kT7YW5OeQGKbO0Cj_zNobFX8Btj23DFlKXZibu7LhwuUjOg3WVa57evPJ8ubiPhe6ybAvdEvg==) [oreateai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGq0K8ewB8-fTXzqMdU2Ge3UN5aCc15Nc-C-9IMn8n7qpFneE6eM2-EdfcBtmcT675W530ulff6_53M8qLAtLs0CSDZcF6LA2qFbovkqqmW2Mj6DkgmbTr8jcxUopvwAyLZstrvNCIE3Xk7ouC6eSbxkg-nZkDrnL-M_K4oDP0i-bjt5Zd_etXIPztfsNJwdovx4wPTeFNfXm66UPXUpevXuaYZKxNCtrEVU-fqM-bgLGL5O020UaHhUizGIbFXSSUaarldhx0IzCZYBB-M9LEeUwdkwJgKgtLbg==).
4.  **Detection, Classification, and Action:** By measuring the time it takes for the waves to travel to the object and back, the radar calculates the distance (range) to the target [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=) [noaa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGpUyzNw8E4thIEHI-QS2xV80Sho8mw5vXNs5dJkboeFtlPmnIL-rQJeQOxrZIA_dReIug7NXrvOatu9kT7YW5OeQGKbO0Cj_zNobFX8Btj23DFlKXZibu7LhwuUjOg3WVa57evPJ8ubiPhe6ybAvdEvg==) [radartutorial](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZcQ3mkYWEdFCa4kBzaFloHvTq9Zlwxs9w92kxl1LnqHIRhcRiRa7V1NaVKXm5FBV7_BL8F9jqezuLvYQFOHzzKYqC6__U41ouc2p8wDqOGicg1oA6bYJ7mQgPsZ8AihFtYi5moipvjWqQ7OiNh9dw0MIbvSwTJEadx9Q=). The signal processor then analyzes this data in real-time to determine the target's trajectory and potential threat level [lockheedmartin](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF-LuDvRlwB0V8bJQukSLIGjBB5Deygp9wjGvR37uJpa0is1xP1BHfsTFpHwAp0V8dK8F5yHBrqPJHz3NmkH-24vAhMZAlYdszejlP5FAMchBE4w4tnUlkTVV4nnb-By-ptyF9Oe4ZWuF2HZ5OdT-vUQbCjI6T4Sua0MoXxwy9LVZQ9hJs9vC5zy0Y=). The Doppler effect can also be used to detect moving targets by observing shifts in the frequency of the reflected radio waves [ogierelectronics](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEvq6DyID0ByEo6FXIAKNKnGujp_Jt0PbMjxjuivey_SSuAXAPFMTN4HN4NE5pUzUmiSYCDcsNa8XuV3FTrfplBRRVp2eOH_OWsZx1uBgNU8p-CeA83DqOGPp7mSBKq65877Lv_p6b5hmf5oM1bh8-nBms6wvEi8BWyrkA=).

Recent advancements are significantly enhancing radar capabilities. The increasing integration of digital components over analog ones allows for real-time adjustments to counter jamming and faster configuration changes [sandia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF4f2XgHHgX8RacoTgqNV83aQVdGsfW6JpnGbcv_F8OK54FzwPVZYM2OVF9-3IpuCoulQksyUvBWrZ4wiGk2BXCmkhNgcfPVG3eBQXAywbCapESk5FOjn4HYRTuUbcmF5G0oKjJknq4BWMBwkkpM0GOWrk7iuRUU0Abyrx8fb5rdnbAaBxba98Qt5P5WDXteSVoRb8QL693qeeTWxh0KmuO-jCExf4NHKG8b2t3Sg==). Technologies like Active Electronically Scanned Arrays (AESAs) offer increased power and resolution by electronically steering beams [ni](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFTClXvF_4VCqP49hPljZ1TaCUoRmmvtnBaMOHiUuYMrugsJCTf1X0MAOInPNgag3Xk8d-1TdlLmcPCmTAUA2lBfDYBzcVpn0dHWyWvYbhVsqoOhCED2i8X9fZzW0KT4i8yz4xRkFis0E-fSWgkZsFxSlfXtZUSAzqsBXvgNimEkwSL3SLLYkj8HHGhReeUIicJ7EKxLYiWhl99-0Ex3xwztjkO5xiXIW9L0Gp1f5G78-vOJX99-FvffLCBgayQFqP8jM2Y1Wo59a06rq1D). The fusion of radar technology with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning is revolutionizing data analysis and decision-making, leading to more reliable autonomous systems [startus-insights](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHsyPJZEDxrOLD4Lv9o5NMhKVPKFNpzuCIhrkK1OFPn2LiupdlMt_9C41nOQBgem65Vclsgn9GsIOdTS7-vU_lfy9t9-ZmhnHJ1RVHujdWc6bqXZMup_jVlgfMjHFhrkUOFqg==2) [globenewswire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFDLVcTggjFx8nUMSSqfV76PFjS3vdiLwOJlxZHKn3Fvg0ox-JwevTsDtooCFFVvs_nC2ut369VIn20dYbgahHmZ3KpvJ6HSOW-ovhogM95zLaIbq-iOGF9DyphRciVF7R99XSewq0WOX8jHanKMV67OSaOEKVy9t7Wa343Zxacaam2jnUVCTo1AAItgFHSAglRWThL7z6wN7NC7vbF1G6PLwXTaMWyymByhPv22_joW8Zy-_dF0s1t07ztjMysFR43jd7Bb4UdE6M-ucDASxDtoWl2fIsfsxup_ZBVbM0HmWHrgrjVR2ur5mjVQMC5bKTKPIrXH7DwqibWwWcSG4B6To8WvEbVJdkBhSDNBvaLhoJ7eA93VwOlG4TttRMO-n_n) [sandia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGOD4ngjmzVJnqfY7j9u7A1gZMwoNk_rNh2AYzuufvS7tHdWiaAFNG1M4l4bemMxaFq1f1_I1Qu1GWM8VRLx0v1soZZ7MpoWvBhtvSohrrxEQSTudy5XKsQ_Ky-p09RtWcoFfIKzT1P0AP-ThbcO4aNLKcHqqmsGCQQLVJ3OA7lGghuNGQ5v96xPQDoxFGTp-tsv-w_E7Mba_7TxXcMhfOauWhRn_FN5pqnLyn9-Q==) [ni](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHpzWwmTyN73OU1XjOVFNxQQuex-fVbmxMApJkJLxK5gx3WMfHAK8iu7KIcTL8MkFBLVJ54XabpIJFkrna6mrbL5lW908nu_-9e1Mmwcy-97KTv_duqD_LN_31hxOCHuzzujvlzbbDxNWED_1vlUN2y6rykH_HOIR52lmQtib9bv0QSB0gzzZ8w26E5uENiZ5YYBZkFdRlXwM-76JNDCyKCkvTiYqP6JU1_uh6ON8ZRPCu66rcyJkrTEs5Fjcf3dDFrqxASRFGY_JWJig3M) [einpresswire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHxORYkaEmtfnLwFx44v9f4qh8UFtt007EAHT522y-mvJoRrJHxvCTf-SaejPKIXe0A8kWzrxSvGdWfrpT13f5-iqeZcYOseQGaVv-idVN1xILEOrma6k5fn5cE90cljlwg6BsuZhu4gp7YbiLDk_1fdfemtNqUZuRl9nS1KOmgTuzTlJZ_cppWoqBT_XfpoOxHWy-nTXJvZFQnw3h89VmfA48607hRwzpF_jpT7UYz-uP__sz1wAfD5JeCLZs3477rNNdCQYzIUP1GUiR_hnfVosM0l38kfSSpT2B2). Cognitive radar systems, in particular, use AI to adapt their operation based on the environment [ni](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFTClXvF_4VCqP49hPljZ1TaCUoRmmvtnBaMOHiUuYMrugsJCTf1X0MAOInPNgag3Xk8d-1TdlLmcPCmTAUA2lBfDYBzcVpn0dHWyWvYbhVsqoOhCED2i8X9fZzW0KT4i8yz4xRkFis0E-fSWgkZsFxSlfXtZUSAzqsBXvgNimEkwSL3SLLYkj8HHGhReeUIicJ7EKxLYiWhl99-0Ex3xwztjkO5xiXIW9L0Gp1f5G78-vOJX99-FvffLCBgayQFqP8jM2Y1Wo59a06rq1D). Gallium Nitride (GaN) is also being used for front-end components due to its performance benefits [ni](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFTClXvF_4VCqP49hPljZ1TaCUoRmmvtnBaMOHiUuYMrugsJCTf1X0MAOInPNgag3Xk8d-1TdlLmcPCmTAUA2lBfDYBzcVpn0dHWyWvYbhVsqoOhCED2i8X9fZzW0KT4i8yz4xRkFis0E-fSWgkZsFxSlfXtZUSAzqsBXvgNimEkwSL3SLLYkj8HHGhReeUIicJ7EKxLYiWhl99-0Ex3xwztjkO5xiXIW9L0Gp1f5G78-vOJX99-FvffLCBgayQFqP8jM2Y1Wo59a06rq1D) [ni](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQETrXg-0td8D9KoALuN3q4aY63F4V7o4VqIxma3KYgtZE5dF0-JoWC-zErHw2e4HKNbHNIzctJ1BIVdFWLCZ0UJrgKEo9zfYo0cTA_taEliuM9rMJni1ZFGN2T7nz2qF2fnl6oiLtEl28Zd8iPxZDCLnkkW44q5F0Jt6_0f9JcpdKysx-vGlrVn1ErUi0BVFxdVdqB-ryEYRn5M1QA18VJSzKKY_q7WWyQQ8kH6yu86NhhSB6TCtfPhXx8qn1Gvld2z-hKFjqQZk8jbe2I=) [toile-libre](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH3nrx5UEBP8xZJsLud4Ugys3nff8ySVT2joh25cnvWogPGRnoRsAiSlPmpxjLz58IbhqOMaXnsPpAhLGu9IZ2tSDv5am8GbBMVsDbQJLD5Qyb56uNLZLdXNjBFilahybOcjrAMvW4jM_d8VPXMNZ5BYnB-lwLCY8Q=) [raypcb](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG5OBmTW4LaxiJrkJgGIv4c2zgaJVcJz-lXkUNM9_RzsJdOgeqSNv933q42oizHjFrcULtQynt_v7vGNmoHfZwBEtmW6_nU0ZExELa0D12P9-w4_2kTJeQ8mov3g-QbYc25zTQ=). @eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

Without this field, elementary particles would be massless and travel at the speed of light, preventing the formation of atoms, stars, planets, and life as we know it [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).

**Key Properties of the Higgs Boson:**

*   **Mass:** Its mass has been precisely measured. Experiments by CMS in 2022 yielded a mass of approximately 125.35±0.15 GeV/c², while ATLAS measurements in 2023 provided 125.11±0.11 GeV/c² [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).
*   **Spin and Parity:** It has zero spin and even (positive) parity [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).
*   **Charge:** It carries no electric charge and no color charge [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).
*   **Instability:** The Higgs boson is highly unstable and decays into other particles almost immediately after its creation [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).
*   **Coupling:** It interacts with other particles in proportion to their masses, a key aspect of the Higgs mechanism [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).

**Discovery and Ongoing Research:**

The Higgs boson was discovered in 2012 by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN [apnews](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=). This discovery was the culmination of a decades-long theoretical and experimental effort, with theoretical predictions dating back to 1964. Peter Higgs and François Englert were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 2013 for their work on the Higgs mechanism [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhpEzZmT29UEEa2vyXPQeQtTY4egPFf8qFUd527Skrpb_e65XXI_7BYG9j5n_iP1VrP5CVpGBgZ-W3VvkzKijKFONipgzKicUDBgtQZv6e7ZK1BnheHydqDOnwE-5hf_VeJAk=).

Since its discovery, research has focused on precisely measuring the Higgs boson's properties and interactions. Recent evidence, including findings presented in 2025, has confirmed rare Higgs boson decays, such as its decay into muons (H→μμ) and into a Z boson and a photon (H→Zγ) [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEHMCF5AApBooTZxFigwRKRoMzx4Z8ASs-7J3bHW61N9J-pG0Sx8agNgZkOiMOc2ua_pdgev0RJz2PXg4IfP2WSGRXev7sBXp7haSZ5Od-oLKgIjTVEGn-hxo-_exFwLtcbFXI=3). These rare decay modes are crucial for testing the Standard Model's predictions with high accuracy and for searching for evidence of new physics beyond the Standard Model [innovationnewsnetwork](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEHMCF5AApBooTZxFigwRKRoMzx4Z8ASs-7J3bHW61N9J-pG0Sx8agNgZkOiMOc2ua_pdgev0RJz2PXg4IfP2WSGRXev7sBXp7haSZ5Od-oLKgIjTVEGn-hxo-_exFwLtcbFXI=1). Scientists are also investigating Higgs boson pair production (HH) to understand its self-coupling and searching for additional Higgs bosons predicted by various theories [fiveable](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEHMCF5AApBooTZxFigwRKRoMzx4Z8ASs-7J3bHW61N9J-pG0Sx8agNgZkOiMOc2ua_pdgev0RJz2PXg4IfP2WSGRXev7sBXp7haSZ5Od-oLKgIjTVEGn-hxo-_exFwLtcbFXI=0). The LHC is undergoing upgrades to the High-Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC) to further enhance precision measurements and probe deeper into the mysteries surrounding the Higgs boson [innovationnewsnetwork](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEHMCF5AApBooTZxFigwRKRoMzx4Z8ASs-7J3bHW61N9J-pG0Sx8agNgZkOiMOc2ua_pdgev0RJz2PXg4IfP2WSGRXev7sBXp7haSZ5Od-oLKgIjTVEGn-hxo-_exFwLtcbFXI=1).

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

These electrons travel through an external circuit, creating an electrical current that powers a device [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8WlIYvntZU6wm0zbHe8w3fZSmYlNL_SiCebkTedeGAiZNOyofXN0SunrQVKAFwnasQ0hYaa2fn2dn8Qk8JZvXI6p6b_A3Qahl7DBb7T7sWkAW8f7BhU38ZmiF8MORVVpp4dtKw7MYooLjfNn5MJyJPRNl0muzt5jPOTsJJpw6F_OgDlCk) [okmotech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGK1O3dHlTA3in__bOFKO7kwPkr8ytt-ibc-wILeCHj3JVHeBYvp4wdeo6SqYg1SE24oxNWc8PkXBnv5dfZtlMRNpSk6XARMhb7IjyxUNx_VnqPjrGweYy9VD_mFsP30DHUh2DegRhYPAaidfoWID6poVF_cDxWWA0Zqolwavw=). **Key Components of a Rechargeable Battery:**

*   **Anode:** Commonly graphite, it stores lithium ions during charging [monolithai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1wSLt-YGomM9o9H5erbi_cIjiN_l0MNM-egOKJmxEEnCoafZGQRd33NM2KylLgiOoyV1iYWODX4_bK0faGeyG83CMO6xYMMDtzyH6Yl5e78bbo9PfK9iQ2twWGpDaIlFmxUIbi7m66NVt4S-PhMwPnbJNPL3pUTst8T-O-04=) [okmotech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGK1O3dHlTA3in__bOFKO7kwPkr8ytt-ibc-wILeCHj3JVHeBYvp4wdeo6SqYg1SE24oxNWc8PkXBnv5dfZtlMRNpSk6XARMhb7IjyxUNx_VnqPjrGweYy9VD_mFsP30DHUh2DegRhYPAaidfoWID6poVF_cDxWWA0Zqolwavw=) [eszoneo](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGxrTQb_Z9OK7tehHaprIJk7bPEbP1mtGyVZwK84N0fnOeOKh1dIo-bne2ShSlECwGNBLkP2_JPjF7uAmhO3ti2MmE8F6V5SSRRVhCJwuJJ-mMIdw_9Rl4TBeC_DYgKkMWm_peST0afpZavxCLd5sml1aJzTLKhaMbf0UkdWALhFWq1Rcp3uJQ0E9JDvHLXYy2HKw6-GQ4c6lUYFQ==).
*   **Cathode:** Typically a lithium-based compound (e.g., lithium cobalt oxide), it releases lithium ions during discharge.
*   **Electrolyte:** A medium (liquid, gel, or solid) containing a lithium salt that allows lithium ions to move between electrodes [monolithai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1wSLt-YGomM9o9H5erbi_cIjiN_l0MNM-egOKJmxEEnCoafZGQRd33NM2KylLgiOoyV1iYWODX4_bK0faGeyG83CMO6xYMMDtzyH6Yl5e78bbo9PfK9iQ2twWGpDaIlFmxUIbi7m66NVt4S-PhMwPnbJNPL3pUTst8T-O-04=) [okmotech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGK1O3dHlTA3in__bOFKO7kwPkr8ytt-ibc-wILeCHj3JVHeBYvp4wdeo6SqYg1SE24oxNWc8PkXBnv5dfZtlMRNpSk6XARMhb7IjyxUNx_VnqPjrGweYy9VD_mFsP30DHUh2DegRhYPAaidfoWID6poVF_cDxWWA0Zqolwavw=) [ossila](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF3eYzsMJ7AeA6ULkIK2XrlMsxuxbgHblw40gb1gmln6hC0G4JKlrobmSaQXQLdISjUoAHr5hIuF0A8Q-IFb90JwmqAYhy36dZpxfs_xSmUQKGAoiyzIgVwqLgG4vaQButbRKJS6ItCLMtrQ65m).
*   **Separator:** A porous material that physically separates the anode and cathode while permitting ion passage [global](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZcgdfBO6S5n2zruER6-KUuy8aaUUT7kHCd3N82Z0HBBEiWZWEwHeVfiSfKRSpYnXGDHuSc4KhZmB9I1T1paqHTQBblRXBhHw_KoT4SdgJi-RGMcNZu9FMdvpxdoNrrBDaf43hdjebJxUphLx57eQAl4gZkAcBHZ0NugEaNzRwTwt6w_0-k3JDOeEY6gQLqA7lALat8f_DR5bF5Kx_RUNnwQYNQg==) [energyx](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHrypVJ9Awls9ubh5oJtQCxX32ft8He3cf6F2BKvIMjZSD7pIahl7ezShPA0gfhvx48TVRLPsRMWluaY6oalA2UQJVdzNnzfeN4azjdBeIA-h7p3BuL4whvQKzBmolzsBwzuloaF6mBbtZdby8SToioFszY6ikbs0Y=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQECdv4HFxdKd9u5eMbYYDQ8tyI40rDeGYutbYKyVtACDnLCrYhcJqY0HKOMcKxs0mRlQ3fCJ-vdtBhgjZHPhJpwVeRLauFau8YcCaf5rBCvESZLGUQx1zyAdzVQ4J6tY383Pp-HEn_qS0XNuvY=).
*   **Current Collectors:** Conductive foils that support the electrodes and facilitate electron flow to the external circuit [global](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZcgdfBO6S5n2zruER6-KUuy8aaUUT7kHCd3N82Z0HBBEiWZWEwHeVfiSfKRSpYnXGDHuSc4KhZmB9I1T1paqHTQBblRXBhHw_KoT4SdgJi-RGMcNZu9FMdvpxdoNrrBDaf43hdjebJxUphLx57eQAl4gZkAcBHZ0NugEaNzRwTwt6w_0-k3JDOeEY6gQLqA7lALat8f_DR5bF5Kx_RUNnwQYNQg==) [energyx](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHrypVJ9Awls9ubh5oJtQCxX32ft8He3cf6F2BKvIMjZSD7pIahl7ezShPA0gfhvx48TVRLPsRMWluaY6oalA2UQJVdzNnzfeN4azjdBeIA-h7p3BuL4whvQKzBmolzsBwzuloaF6mBbtZdby8SToioFszY6ikbs0Y=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQECdv4HFxdKd9u5eMbYYDQ8tyI40rDeGYutbYKyVtACDnLCrYhcJqY0HKOMcKxs0mRlQ3fCJ-vdtBhgjZHPhJpwVeRLauFau8YcCaf5rBCvESZLGUQx1zyAdzVQ4J6tY383Pp-HEn_qS0XNuvY=).

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a satellite-based navigation system that provides users with precise location and time information anywhere on or near Earth. It operates through a system comprising three main segments: the space segment (a constellation of satellites), the control segment (ground-based stations), and the user segment (GPS receivers) [nasa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHEml_yW8VYSA16vZl_dow6bcmFF1YanvzXZQTyiQpwfJjoRim4SZ2jP7bFqkyfzTW10U08MpRaj_oxDnTT0_9MoHMafBZ_8pDYBCNlhrzFWhBSfvT_3TaDJ1zh6s0qCv3AmhMYrClA_PkXV4Rk-usB16YEhChpVHJHSeq8TTVfWyIkAI--2zTMUjw4B40=) [geotab](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-ElmWfe8ekJtsT4bWG7nNgj0FzNYVgLbDif3owUjWlnSlTwPrjbUxlOjsE2VGJHkSFDlIfaoilJWKID0TDGtboKilJDBKuKoa33c01Ppjp1DkW0H5Xypr0o6lcZLATsaQnA==) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE5ofO5MvTBnecVkVeNvcM4cv-e0M3fA2pTgbkS7a4ERm4-Q-jGG1TlpDA3Ibe6ovSpWj87ujM7x8TlyU4h6-6GnLrCd7oSqVWzfa2TtYH9jAvQ497Y4uRzu6FiVTmtt3-u6HnAT9tm32PAnHPEJslExw==).

**How GPS Works:**

At its core, GPS relies on a technique called trilateration [geotab](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-ElmWfe8ekJtsT4bWG7nNgj0FzNYVgLbDif3owUjWlnSlTwPrjbUxlOjsE2VGJHkSFDlIfaoilJWKID0TDGtboKilJDBKuKoa33c01Ppjp1DkW0H5Xypr0o6lcZLATsaQnA==). The approximately 24 GPS satellites orbit the Earth at an altitude of about 20,200 kilometers [nasa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHEml_yW8VYSA16vZl_dow6bcmFF1YanvzXZQTyiQpwfJjoRim4SZ2jP7bFqkyfzTW10U08MpRaj_oxDnTT0_9MoHMafBZ_8pDYBCNlhrzFWhBSfvT_3TaDJ1zh6s0qCv3AmhMYrClA_PkXV4Rk-usB16YEhChpVHJHSeq8TTVfWyIkAI--2zTMUjw4B40=). These satellites are equipped with highly accurate atomic clocks and continuously broadcast signals containing their precise location and the exact time the signal was transmitted [taoglas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGzJIn0wOYNJvos3xo5AzPAHzFNK6jplN1XG_7dTfbRXWV5lBbWb6uBAhjwPlhRGNG1msNJT-F6f5ryKTtESvR-lbslrIVTXLbB0SrtERGv2yzRmJBvX0iPcXurUyDLidxgboKEsB4w-mMd1PidqcaZp4P5NxwngzuHIlzKuKpr-qWQ).

A GPS receiver needs to receive signals from at least four satellites to accurately calculate its position [geotab](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-ElmWfe8ekJtsT4bWG7nNgj0FzNYVgLbDif3owUjWlnSlTwPrjbUxlOjsE2VGJHkSFDlIfaoilJWKID0TDGtboKilJDBKuKoa33c01Ppjp1DkW0H5Xypr0o6lcZLATsaQnA==). By measuring the time it takes for these signals to reach the receiver and knowing the speed of light, the receiver can determine the distance to each satellite [geotab](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-ElmWfe8ekJtsT4bWG7nNgj0FzNYVgLbDif3owUjWlnSlTwPrjbUxlOjsE2VGJHkSFDlIfaoilJWKID0TDGtboKilJDBKuKoa33c01Ppjp1DkW0H5Xypr0o6lcZLATsaQnA==). With distances to at least three satellites, the receiver can pinpoint its location on Earth's surface (latitude and longitude). A fourth satellite is crucial for synchronizing the receiver's clock with the satellite time, allowing for the calculation of altitude and the receiver's exact time [geotab](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-ElmWfe8ekJtsT4bWG7nNgj0FzNYVgLbDif3owUjWlnSlTwPrjbUxlOjsE2VGJHkSFDlIfaoilJWKID0TDGtboKilJDBKuKoa33c01Ppjp1DkW0H5Xypr0o6lcZLATsaQnA==).

**Evolution and Trends Towards 2026:**

As of early 2026, the focus of GPS technology is shifting from raw accuracy alone to enhancing reliability, consistency, and integration within a broader ecosystem of positioning technologies [gpsdaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHonzMTQ6Djtx2HwkpDfuNa_yuc_n-C4hcYqvEULMLO1ZQ2MLfNXrH0gvIShlKgufJjulZGkIOGIBc03I5kQj79zQjzmiuf4mNxrAfORvdHAsxIoVruILX-umcTM_UHMV1n26fz6IU3n5l03zO5qFSifJwdlzJPt6BAyd-_GlBANAsrjYF-bXCgQO8X3EWr_jr_I-7rSH-Irs0GA7lTflQdCGJV) [spacedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a). While the fundamental principles remain the same, key trends include:

*   **Emphasis on Reliability and Consistency:** The ability of GPS to maintain consistent positioning, even during signal interference or temporary disruptions, is becoming a primary metric [gpsdaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHonzMTQ6Djtx2HwkpDfuNa_yuc_n-C4hcYqvEULMLO1ZQ2MLfNXrH0gvIShlKgufJjulZGkIOGIBc03I5kQj79zQjzmiuf4mNxrAfORvdHAsxIoVruILX-umcTM_UHMV1n26fz6IU3n5l03zO5qFSifJwdlzJPt6BAyd-_GlBANAsrjYF-bXCgQO8X3EWr_jr_I-7rSH-Irs0GA7lTflQdCGJV) [spacedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a).
*   **Layered Positioning Models:** GPS is increasingly integrated with other Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) like Galileo and GLONASS, as well as terrestrial signals and onboard sensors. This creates a more robust and redundant navigation framework, reducing reliance on any single signal source and improving performance in challenging environments [spacedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a) [planningtank](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFBlyHHZdYQSmMCv9yowBZj8rmXWmQr8dA2AUsV_ZTpDsX5TubQJdhmL-w9VQE2Zy3P6WImAVdfRG7nbqY671sKXbzrH9WOyUG6yOrokomz9Y_hi27aVrOYZG66BNNge5jo9sqhOrtmbUcmTXRoPxxH2SHJMPofF7RFaG2JW7KVEWYJ2Lv37FsYLrIhVY7k9nfgsjM5veY=).
*   **Modernization of the Constellation:** The introduction of GPS III and GPS IIIF satellites is enhancing accuracy and broadcasting more powerful, secure, and interoperable signals, making the system more resistant to interference [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE5ofO5MvTBnecVkVeNvcM4cv-e0M3fA2pTgbkS7a4ERm4-Q-jGG1TlpDA3Ibe6ovSpWj87ujM7x8TlyU4h6-6GnLrCd7oSqVWzfa2TtYH9jAvQ497Y4uRzu6FiVTmtt3-u6HnAT9tm32PAnHPEJslExw==).
*   **Datum Modernization:** In 2026, North America is implementing updated geodetic reference systems (datums) like NATRF2022 and NAPGD2022. This modernization aims for better compatibility with GNSS and improved accuracy, though it may cause shifts in coordinates [no-tillfarmer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a1) [iastate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a2) [iowadot](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF2NH93xo8q-kuCXTcNwnCpqCJVfvhsLW4xeYIoV426FMT8sUjZKF5ZzWjy3oW2jwPvQaHNHzzdPzyQYpfUC0jenYtxzCGwbxmy798gQRuXCkoH4SzlCmhP1NARonYO1k2M-zL0X1qSB9tnIyoBme1ap8FRlQdbB5i7dU6qgnu7).
*   **Advanced Signal Processing:** Modern receivers utilize advanced techniques for newer signals like L2C and L5. These signals offer improved accuracy and interference resistance through multi-frequency processing, advanced signal structures, and enhanced ionospheric and multipath error correction [uniquenav](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFYIp4s0jmN0n9vWuz9BLT0pwXjSd85EKzAkh6baMC1oSdFn_unQ3U7T5bAVUE9WpQLpkwllnWR8nUF5tcvSb9wxYumRyuXSil4yNmExb83i0IZLeNIsMQbEYQbhcnRw0L5hVCBFN6bWrsTaAjpoilQwg5XPk-EwfJZHNPzshtd6F6v5KUyZ9Zd0-RJV0CQWwEgES8aLL-Dzg==) [swiftnav](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEjKtX_WJUXB0aB3kG2n-0luBvk1Slkq6HiKDjOBV8ZuCNA3jRZyLumiJ99zJZa7ZNNf3VgxsWY5GMERusGS3chZEmhPD-9H-itI4wDiBMLDqC3Dg6oHWZLE6DdJn7xSoe7niYbqbG5bRW6_T3EWhe0yUXA7OXyOQABsnOOFSLZcWtVreAH2jPWbCjPpOeaWfSiMAQ1VHTnS8mSx8MnP4BJLrZ0MDWxgXtQNoNY_5eP).

These shifts are driven by the growing demand for uninterrupted positioning in complex environments and the need for greater resilience in Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) security [gpsdaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHonzMTQ6Djtx2HwkpDfuNa_yuc_n-C4hcYqvEULMLO1ZQ2MLfNXrH0gvIShlKgufJjulZGkIOGIBc03I5kQj79zQjzmiuf4mNxrAfORvdHAsxIoVruILX-umcTM_UHMV1n26fz6IU3n5l03zO5qFSifJwdlzJPt6BAyd-_GlBANAsrjYF-bXCgQO8X3EWr_jr_I-7rSH-Irs0GA7lTflQdCGJV) [spacedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH2kEsUaThW-Ci4YoK3qRerHEkqcW0zYJKwW2OJX0Luu6JoohKp5bpfbKRs0n_fBREg6KLhYpCe99edgRR-xSHG-PyGTY0SQpltW-HuliAsz0xR6MBAUuXSQLwTO7arMtayQdbVRSn8OqDhHWwpr6AogUs19p6ucyC0b3xCyQcruBn_J1IHVqQ8-rwgKxDbghSMInZqgWSTTX-a). code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

**How Proof-of-Work Mining Functions:**

Proof-of-Work (PoW) is a fundamental consensus mechanism in blockchain technology, notably used by cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin. It requires network participants, known as miners, to expend significant computational effort to solve complex mathematical puzzles. This process is essential for validating transactions, securing the network, and adding new blocks of verified transactions to the blockchain [investopedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGQhjpr0MZ4N2wC78SknlpwsB1JoHPm2Hd595I2vCIi-2CNbL3uFs4I8ftLuxQ82lGOdEG2XhmYInINAfYC9KKku5Sra57mVC-eECVKPR_5ZC7lXy89_CF3yrnEX_1l2XucwCdXU6NgWZYRmzOuAg==) [coinbase](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHlzpcx0vv_qeYV4G2wqMaVjYrwEUqMpexzMWFcS5bDGyxu25HFQN5jds6Y3uQmiJAhYribpQ2E9a3RzTIhQibOW-QfeSIraN4jvFr39g0057RPlgQgsBkR6vIhtN1dztrIoXuWTFey2npHMo3OksxGcipH0_XqxRtWh4JKBKidOpgoHlgQjBLcq070V2lwPw==) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHm8o00uM1CTzckpCs7BM5QVEx5k83VBfN9qXiX8CNAVjq90Znma9BSFBccV9jaZhDRni5dl4chIA92wbiiWPsdX9o2EPYLJZtMBQUqqSFgjrXBAZYyQuwJnnG3MbWWfbSIHwQ_AGf6xLiaLHaYqS_kVelPFwDwh48poRT7bllmTFalreFklg==).

1.  **Transaction Grouping:** Miners collect pending transactions and organize them into a proposed block [ecos](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEJuBDqxchC_7Pjb46SR8x1ljK8Da5oqNEh_pLkVmUXx-Ugl0mSBh5Sh97WYpKGfvhM2oOZE6llf4dkhmdAp__okCNHmuVgAMyeJdFaSZw_YpX7eS-HET8XaeSHS6Rre-IAdmpK1BChfEGT8LrXqxdjR3Rn912BlJhVU98lGGkShScV2_5QkCIi).
2.  **Cryptographic Puzzle:** For each block, a cryptographic puzzle is generated. Miners repeatedly hash the block's data along with a variable number (nonce) until they find a hash that meets a specific network difficulty target [investopedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGQhjpr0MZ4N2wC78SknlpwsB1JoHPm2Hd595I2vCIi-2CNbL3uFs4I8ftLuxQ82lGOdEG2XhmYInINAfYC9KKku5Sra57mVC-eECVKPR_5ZC7lXy89_CF3yrnEX_1l2XucwCdXU6NgWZYRmzOuAg==) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHm8o00uM1CTzckpCs7BM5QVEx5k83VBfN9qXiX8CNAVjq90Znma9BSFBccV9jaZhDRni5dl4chIA92wbiiWPsdX9o2EPYLJZtMBQUqqSFgjrXBAZYyQuwJnnG3MbWWfbSIHwQ_AGf6xLiaLHaYqS_kVelPFwDwh48poRT7bllmTFalreFklg==).
3.  **Competition and Verification:** Miners globally compete to solve this puzzle. The "work" in Proof-of-Work refers to the computational power and energy expended [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFhQ6n9PuV3FoAEUi9J1G6kPhR_xQmbKf4r7UzQaJTrJXIu7YOIdnfXUmC_1z_ITvBs4NI-LLN-XOJo4TEJ3aSufzSs-yJJm68DBLVVnEI7BesFZMPIELnABDxafvvbgrH9T9a63lE=) [blockworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFIX-zKzoQ_0qR1tMCY_3ubWXaYAcosHbqG5uCfY-yZehIYQQHO11zygBjBMUl9_raobvHUxgTnSWKUkQxJsEmB06nv4r_RHdA1qexHad7DTjJEH-iNNJBbrOsz_qpbBc7b5O2IXofK33JuVA==). The solution is difficult to find but easy for others to verify [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHm8o00uM1CTzckpCs7BM5QVEx5k83VBfN9qXiX8CNAVjq90Znma9BSFBccV9jaZhDRni5dl4chIA92wbiiWPsdX9o2EPYLJZtMBQUqqSFgjrXBAZYyQuwJnnG3MbWWfbSIHwQ_AGf6xLiaLHaYqS_kVelPFwDwh48poRT7bllmTFalreFklg==).

Upon verification, the new block is added to the blockchain, and the successful miner receives newly minted cryptocurrency and transaction fees as a reward [coinbase](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHlzpcx0vv_qeYV4G2wqMaVjYrwEUqMpexzMWFcS5bDGyxu25HFQN5jds6Y3uQmiJAhYribpQ2E9a3RzTIhQibOW-QfeSIraN4jvFr39g0057RPlgQgsBkR6vIhtN1dztrIoXuWTFey2npHMo3OksxGcipH0_XqxRtWh4JKBKidOpgoHlgQjBLcq070V2lwPw==) [osl](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHlzpcx0vv_qeYV4G2wqMaVjYrwEUqMpexzMWFcS5bDGyxu25HFQN5jds6Y3uQmiJAhYribpQ2E9a3RzTIhQibOW-QfeSIraN4jvFr39g0057RPlgQgsBkR6vIhtN1dztrIoXuWTFey2npHMo3OksxGcipH0_XqxRtWh4JKBKidOpgoHlgQjBLcq070V2lwPw==1) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHm8o00uM1CTzckpCs7BM5QVEx5k83VBfN9qXiX8CNAVjq90Znma9BSFBccV9jaZhDRni5dl4chIA92wbiiWPsdX9o2EPYLJZtMBQUqqSFgjrXBAZYyQuwJnnG3MbWWfbSIHwQ_AGf6xLiaLHaYqS_kVelPFwDwh48poRT7bllmTFalreFklg==).

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

This complex system comprises two main, interconnected subsystems: the innate immune system and the adaptive immune system [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEoA26D4uMY2FON8z45435VnnDs46RqFFrfeNFOfhaXtXgYBAntGhFPEM1zjCB3DmSzbpcN4HT6qIedXnL3jVGSjJCTU_Fmam9shqIVgYSl6fIV1Xfhw3s0l7lY3y11Dm3bCsEdEiVhsw==) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFd4Py54LIFvVuFAHRD59nDdF1vlRguHm6AA8oLWLne_vUfHq-3icOQmNMlUV2ha9j9kB0CEB74jjabnXsClRJfoqmcadkZI2uiHF4eILUCO8dMApLbUi7YQWjz6vq1_f41_I6b8L6e5A==).

### Innate Immune System

The innate immune system serves as the body's first line of defense. It acts rapidly and non-specifically against any perceived threat [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEoA26D4uMY2FON8z45435VnnDs46RqFFrfeNFOfhaXtXgYBAntGhFPEM1zjCB3DmSzbpcN4HT6qIedXnL3jVGSjJCTU_Fmam9shqIVgYSl6fIV1Xfhw3s0l7lY3y11Dm3bCsEdEiVhsw==) [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHvI-9QjpRzNrXxNzda-eW13WV0kNLXCvkLDCKH9_KU3oRvq5T3XWt-2OgxxBGE37ll8ZNveP4QoH5MfXdBj48Ca3Akw8Jg6sSxf_NO278BFysDbkkvMAz8kUOHtEYZO8q9ATessnNcL8mPLm751EekjYyXEv9APYSV) [technologynetworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEFi5NEvZTXIvnbqYNBmphHkG5iT-dDIZT2NhS_4dL6sqOy_p749S-mYj8UX2Uaib4PvDlYla6ESlShzyOhgBLdf7gKQBvL59zleXA3JX-J0jq7a3EOcIO4hwt2N_Rnps3onGNX4pclljVcwlsSW5FnIZgolZ00GcLTBBkAVsextoYKLeNS6kFlRJeAcJtH-g18-XQ_). This system includes physical and chemical barriers such as the skin, mucous membranes, stomach acid, tears, saliva, and sweat, which prevent pathogens from entering the body or inhibit their growth [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEoA26D4uMY2FON8z45435VnnDs46RqFFrfeNFOfhaXtXgYBAntGhFPEM1zjCB3DmSzbpcN4HT6qIedXnL3jVGSjJCTU_Fmam9shqIVgYSl6fIV1Xfhw3s0l7lY3y11Dm3bCsEdEiVhsw==) [bupa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFXtCz3zTMNzI9VyGvS57hPoA-5yTpQgEQWiiissGgIDeIV1-2mkL2niBm6gbxhQFeQ2I_OPRaaGoqTx5qtqI9oAnDhasWGclTQ1kduFT4IfGXfo614TJaBk5BO-ZMm_fMb6QNbBKyi2V1s7sUUlCNmqEsRN02XO16IwGdV) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGo1_36e1lMmbLCdIky_kTAGVpYgbcxuz9xQ7voatpjjmj2_DJlpD5O4kWExV14-u13HjOcRnz7Ah4W0dVTu28B-ykJMhIvwEqdtX776IaPULIEOfGKwZ2xvpC2pXSw-VxvVoL4dP8=) [technologynetworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEFi5NEvZTXIvnbqYNBmphHkG5iT-dDIZT2NhS_4dL6sqOy_p749S-mYj8UX2Uaib4PvDlYla6ESlShzyOhgBLdf7gKQBvL59zleXA3JX-J0jq7a3EOcIO4hwt2N_Rnps3onGNX4pclljVcwlsSW5FnIZgolZ00GcLTBBkAVsextoYKLeNS6kFlRJeAcJtH-g18-XQ_). If these barriers are breached, immune cells like phagocytes (e.g., neutrophils and macrophages) and proteins are activated to engulf and destroy the invaders [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEoA26D4uMY2FON8z45435VnnDs46RqFFrfeNFOfhaXtXgYBAntGhFPEM1zjCB3DmSzbpcN4HT6qIedXnL3jVGSjJCTU_Fmam9shqIVgYSl6fIV1Xfhw3s0l7lY3y11Dm3bCsEdEiVhsw==) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFd4Py54LIFvVuFAHRD59nDdF1vlRguHm6AA8oLWLne_vUfHq-3icOQmNMlUV2ha9j9kB0CEB74jjabnXsClRJfoqmcadkZI2uiHF4eILUCO8dMApLbUi7YQWjz6vq1_f41_I6b8L6e5A==) [medicalnewstoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQERF-jemKd-6dyoHn7YhYTRMa-8Q8grXBpvppLv6qnYHL6CMGlFZzeXLQ2SHFKVe6GUfz0Z2VkDX9iKUBCnox2vn467lUJd7IJ6NyDcEV3lGDdbg_mW-KjGGTfHhjDxbOQIXvDrnrkvzBJwSQ==). The innate immune system does not have a memory of past infections [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHvI-9QjpRzNrXxNzda-eW13WV0kNLXCvkLDCKH9_KU3oRvq5T3XWt-2OgxxBGE37ll8ZNveP4QoH5MfXdBj48Ca3Akw8Jg6sSxf_NO278BFysDbkkvMAz8kUOHtEYZO8q9ATessnNcL8mPLm751EekjYyXEv9APYSV).

Also known as acquired or specific immunity, the adaptive immune system develops over time through exposure to pathogens or vaccination [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHvI-9QjpRzNrXxNzda-eW13WV0kNLXCvkLDCKH9_KU3oRvq5T3XWt-2OgxxBGE37ll8ZNveP4QoH5MfXdBj48Ca3Akw8Jg6sSxf_NO278BFysDbkkvMAz8kUOHtEYZO8q9ATessnNcL8mPLm751EekjYyXEv9APYSV) [bupa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFXtCz3zTMNzI9VyGvS57hPoA-5yTpQgEQWiiissGgIDeIV1-2mkL2niBm6gbxhQFeQ2I_OPRaaGoqTx5qtqI9oAnDhasWGclTQ1kduFT4IfGXfo614TJaBk5BO-ZMm_fMb6QNbBKyi2V1s7sUUlCNmqEsRN02XO16IwGdV) [kidshealth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHSQPzYHc2n8HjBFiNXJhHPSP4xJAHe4fxAs-n8zaKNuHWIog7BAoW6Q3UeYqGQA1EA8GUVFjaKJ1o4G5k6U-YgGADX-ZSyJSb7b1w0zyv69WzRnOSObAQ7mQGG1p6cmUfJjJIVxiyqkQ==) [technologynetworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEFi5NEvZTXIvnbqYNBmphHkG5iT-dDIZT2NhS_4dL6sqOy_p749S-mYj8UX2Uaib4PvDlYla6ESlShzyOhgBLdf7gKQBvL59zleXA3JX-J0jq7a3EOcIO4hwt2N_Rnps3onGNX4pclljVcwlsSW5FnIZgolZ00GcLTBBkAVsextoYKLeNS6kFlRJeAcJtH-g18-XQ_). code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

Nuclear fusion is a process that involves the merging of atomic nuclei to release vast amounts of energy, with the ultimate goal of providing a clean and virtually limitless power source. This process mimics the energy generation within stars, including our Sun.

The pursuit of controlled nuclear fusion has seen significant advancements, particularly in 2025 and early 2026, marking a shift towards engineering and commercialization efforts. Key fusion approaches include:

*   **Tokamak Reactors:** These are doughnut-shaped devices that use powerful magnetic fields to confine a plasma of hot gas, where fusion reactions can occur. Projects like the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) in France are central to this research, aiming to demonstrate the scientific and technological feasibility of fusion power [jis](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGMnsNqnmW95U121Bqyx8EjVWlHKPT_1po36Xgpkl6jGjZiIx5l8H1DZTb91DeSnNTWnnVBl8Bxwbplpj9UWfN464s4tRxC_oXFj3hnnWfCM9rNmQnmM38Wr5qdQpXMFlvcPBMU4T4Eh6ByLRtF1tEaQDTehCg5jUp09fA2RbB4iEgIb6nXq1kkrCYEnNe7fRClgcpQptXF8Q==) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHB4aJ9kbmqx-z0w77MON61SVZ8AsqScUnL19-ql5NP4gUYsFvFP2CDSCWYUwr32fnNF20009u45hNToTaQZDWRi-U82IB_7QB5lxGsGSydaofamfxAhg6qFwpUQFI=) [learnwithai](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEjoEsiWJyIagEXfWsUM-lI64TP3i63WjeqHbJe3wIqDgeEnToRkPy9cfXTvNxpH7Mjs3ZaxcOI0FhqtM2em7dWKEaLaCWwalNgi73sRd768J1m8tscQClTexRHGsdJYvsYMk8Vwj_eQ4BIS1SJ6DP6ANMAYVCC6lXkvXBJFXzHgha5p-papwP9xu0NsU-4ng==). Following a significant ignition breakthrough at the U.S. National Ignition Facility, research is now focused on improving the efficiency and repeatability of this process for power-plant scalability [jis](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGMnsNqnmW95U121Bqyx8EjVWlHKPT_1po36Xgpkl6jGjZiIx5l8H1DZTb91DeSnNTWnnVBl8Bxwbplpj9UWfN464s4tRxC_oXFj3hnnWfCM9rNmQnmM38Wr5qdQpXMFlvcPBMU4T4Eh6ByLRtF1tEaQDTehCg5jUp09fA2RbB4iEgIb6nXq1kkrCYEnNe7fRClgcpQptXF8Q==) [cleanenergy-platform](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFa4vY-ZpXauBVehAjCy2OqFULoPWSnG_0J3HqMyyiPgNSfTf2vTv5I2CbXG2t4AQZYhbOLzjaqfnrtkeObOz4BJx-jMHMppnqPcRMEjkTSE1ASHoy62Dt6jIulN0CHZqhDhs1g6IJdxRpv608AvRI1gJ2OJSgdCcqEOjm3MLYnbQlXOA8iNc2oG5eJPHIo0mmwj37ft7ECx9M=).

Companies like Helion Energy are developing pulsed fusion architectures with a focus on commercial timelines [cleanenergy-platform](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFFt2ZoHjnG-SbZmu3I3JazhyrposqdrWZJ7lw2vw4-6DarO8zX2sbngh3rQjvTf2gO04lDcJJZccNETHn5k1WWv9xc4O6VBJpspc-MzO4jz6qJeEAKoNbfTKIX30_ALZr-5nwC6uQGW4f_bwVc72BhYFK-VsDYmUFsVq7Skr_yjf2wUF0zxAmCqmzgofeZBlN9xbxd0K3a2Es=) [cleanenergy-platform](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF1e_R1R7XYhNx7cvB2lW5QwmoZlmvsKcplrTirJ2lgUiUIJBFATg4aHY6iAfWi7roBZSJxM5bo77DCGTJkUx8AnNa1-xibjU0tGQdOT_JsFX4gCB2oMVOro-RsHwne99Bi6PMOCyV46osj-6-VnfbOQ9C2FFwOgvz59P0a-_ZqWt4zUJXAdS_epHqUQj4KPA==).

*   **Materials Science:** Developing materials that can withstand the extreme heat, radiation, and magnetic fields within a fusion reactor is critical for its longevity and safety [jis](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFeQACjkh9l2MvwPOFGEqG1C8Po3CBwB965pyz0Wn0W6IV4j6gXUgF6bpdrUKWTasMi_Lpwh5veSvjNZA15DF7BXST4Vg6pvLWHxYpWU3nBz1z_LWNosvCOaCbTS088Jbe1pGIz9fnIXEPNQlVsndJt1ifw_24oFPaHLyg0DwfJdhihBdQRZqT8Pc1OP7v_EEuGz9sdD7dzcw==) [nuclear-power](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFtCj7GgMZmFgUOvsklrdfwA9ANmAO30OJLovKOEaQSDzAfV2-PpNtJzksJluU0tkQPSx40l3cXglh8mYToMmAXhIGgp7R22djQHYnbRKQrFk9M-Z79tvj6u0wXIv_BTDFhVTpZ0a1j0MUVOKdGpmEEBOJ0F-aQQvHHvx8z65nhfKITvZh6PtfTnvZnyMSB2F_v3-U_).
*   **Sustained Net Energy Gain:** The ultimate goal is to produce more energy from the fusion reaction than is consumed to initiate and maintain it [nucnet](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1DY_-8yridOf3DuvKX_b8YP3AAIUlLPoKgK-HcBBrVEZP2_nKEZxhwJFhr7TZw4sJLdiH-Bqk0KoJJRGsKpYw2mMoIfkIca6ikes1Z1C2PlevohP4isAK3CzAtaunwsbt3-wDo40Z8eshasEP0nAV2STGzVYqcxW0BrzyUHksGOztdPLi1).
*   **Tritium Fuel Cycle:** For the most promising fusion fuel (deuterium-tritium), efficiently breeding and managing tritium, a radioactive isotope, is essential for self-sufficiency [peaknano](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1DY_-8yridOf3DuvKX_b8YP3AAIUlLPoKgK-HcBBrVEZP2_nKEZxhwJFhr7TZw4sJLdiH-Bqk0KoJJRGsKpYw2mMoIfkIca6ikes1Z1C2PlevohP4isAK3CzAtaunwsbt3-wDo40Z8eshasEP0nAV2STGzVYqcxW0BrzyUHksGOztdPLi2) [knowablemagazine](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1DY_-8yridOf3DuvKX_b8YP3AAIUlLPoKgK-HcBBrVEZP2_nKEZxhwJFhr7TZw4sJLdiH-Bqk0KoJJRGsKpYw2mMoIfkIca6ikes1Z1C2PlevohP4isAK3CzAtaunwsbt3-wDo40Z8eshasEP0nAV2STGzVYqcxW0BrzyUHksGOztdPLi5).
*   **Engineering Complexity and Economic Viability:** Building and operating fusion reactors present significant engineering hurdles, and achieving cost-effectiveness is crucial for widespread adoption [peaknano](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1DY_-8yridOf3DuvKX_b8YP3AAIUlLPoKgK-HcBBrVEZP2_nKEZxhwJFhr7TZw4sJLdiH-Bqk0KoJJRGsKpYw2mMoIfkIca6ikes1Z1C2PlevohP4isAK3CzAtaunwsbt3-wDo40Z8eshasEP0nAV2STGzVYqcxW0BrzyUHksGOztdPLi2) [nucnet](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1DY_-8yridOf3DuvKX_b8YP3AAIUlLPoKgK-HcBBrVEZP2_nKEZxhwJFhr7TZw4sJLdiH-Bqk0KoJJRGsKpYw2mMoIfkIca6ikes1Z1C2PlevohP4isAK3CzAtaunwsbt3-wDo40Z8eshasEP0nAV2STGzVYqcxW0BrzyUHksGOztdPLi1).

Despite these challenges, the field has seen a surge in private investment, exceeding $10 billion by September 2025, fueling innovation and accelerating development towards commercialization [iaea](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHB4aJ9kbmqx-z0w77MON61SVZ8AsqScUnL19-ql5NP4gUYsFvFP2CDSCWYUwr32fnNF20009u45hNToTaQZDWRi-U82IB_7QB5lxGsGSydaofamfxAhg6qFwpUQFI=3) [futuremarketsinc](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHB4aJ9kbmqx-z0w77MON61SVZ8AsqScUnL19-ql5NP4gUYsFvFP2CDSCWYUwr32fnNF20009u45hNToTaQZDWRi-U82IB_7QB5lxGsGSydaofamfxAhg6qFwpUQFI=6). Advancements in high-temperature superconducting magnets are enabling more compact and efficient reactor designs [cleanenergy-platform](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFa4vY-ZpXauBVehAjCy2OqFULoPWSnG_0J3HqMyyiPgNSfTf2vTv5I2CbXG2t4AQZYhbOLzjaqfnrtkeObOz4BJx-jMHMppnqPcRMEjkTSE1ASHoy62Dt6jIulN0CHZqhDhs1g6IJdxRpv608AvRI1gJ2OJSgdCcqEOjm3MLYnbQlXOA8iNc2oG5eJPHIo0mmwj37ft7ECx9M=) [iaea](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHB4aJ9kbmqx-z0w77MON61SVZ8AsqScUnL19-ql5NP4gUYsFvFP2CDSCWYUwr32fnNF20009u45hNToTaQZDWRi-U82IB_7QB5lxGsGSydaofamfxAhg6qFwpUQFI=3). code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

Computers store data by representing all information as sequences of binary digits, or bits, which are either 0s or 1s [study](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGZOL0p6yJLKWT5lZjRjP3UM5eAYomfdxLUL7cSu7pZSUNfXgBv2qHAiSrULEE7tB0ZsQ4hSbVRJYV45WkAkHHRhytY5-iFKUvBIJSeCQFEOErez905ozMgDYBkbnf_h8yyrd6HUAILPVBHOb_t68cBQGrKj55lnOk=) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFlais-A4_Wn1cmoqkaJ9XFmsLdIhNWnQ1qtuY7HwUb0mdgqJiXb9e51MYSwl4JQMZ-h-8QlPOPZ9lusacskQLpgt3-l9xOLIivRUizo9G3f9gN3NLcDqOfmsbO-2Dn1eypIeqRJ9SnLVWIoIfF2w==). These binary states are physically represented by the on or off states of transistors within the computer's components [study](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGZOL0p6yJLKWT5lZjRjP3UM5eAYomfdxLUL7cSu7pZSUNfXgBv2qHAiSrULEE7tB0ZsQ4hSbVRJYV45WkAkHHRhytY5-iFKUvBIJSeCQFEOErez905ozMgDYBkbnf_h8yyrd6HUAILPVBHOb_t68cBQGrKj55lnOk=) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFlais-A4_Wn1cmoqkaJ9XFmsLdIhNWnQ1qtuY7HwUb0mdgqJiXb9e51MYSwl4JQMZ-h-8QlPOPZ9lusacskQLpgt3-l9xOLIivRUizo9G3f9gN3NLcDqOfmsbO-2Dn1eypIeqRJ9SnLVWIoIfF2w==).

Data storage is broadly categorized into two main types:

*   **Primary Storage (Memory):** This is the computer's main memory, which is directly accessible by the CPU for rapid processing [ebsco](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEr7xgYy1-u6Dv8Zg5MyQN8RnRuiKFK9xNSEaj_5vfTpW56i1ZEsHKo7WeE4QE8YOygRi3-BAUCNmHR4Rj0fmO0dHXkfHmY1rudyoNg0Ixs5SL-hAdB7apBY4-Y1RHnu71UFxLS8KEEkQtnCLKVKnaLoVA13q2QjQ_v2FydJTX0AA==) [snowflake](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGzqNEL_7sUxBRkpxr2VFGyBKd4IX9QF0Zt6hegvZThCE9dkGR6er3tf0-pHbr_r9QDAr0bJ_XaKU8DIMmvvblV2yT-j_H7Rud69_Gu7grjxe2kVeD_aOBqgAHIMl__uZFIz25s4USdxs3Sb0h7sWYW20k=). It includes Random Access Memory (RAM) and CPU cache. Primary storage is volatile, meaning it loses its data when the power is turned off [ebsco](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEr7xgYy1-u6Dv8Zg5MyQN8RnRuiKFK9xNSEaj_5vfTpW56i1ZEsHKo7WeE4QE8YOygRi3-BAUCNmHR4Rj0fmO0dHXkfHmY1rudyoNg0Ixs5SL-hAdB7apBY4-Y1RHnu71UFxLS8KEEkQtnCLKVKnaLoVA13q2QjQ_v2FydJTX0AA==) [snowflake](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGzqNEL_7sUxBRkpxr2VFGyBKd4IX9QF0Zt6hegvZThCE9dkGR6er3tf0-pHbr_r9QDAr0bJ_XaKU8DIMmvvblV2yT-j_H7Rud69_Gu7grjxe2kVeD_aOBqgAHIMl__uZFIz25s4USdxs3Sb0h7sWYW20k=).
    *   **DRAM (Dynamic RAM):** Each bit is stored using a transistor and a capacitor. The capacitor holds an electrical charge, representing a '1', or is discharged, representing a '0' [allaboutcircuits](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHbt0RDxdm20JqcciuAlkl9qYgDtkPPum4Iq9bbE5wJ_g16h_vb1sAfYXmtbwuoCXuhpnS0pOt1nVr9pMTIWgXzlE5kAaFr_99TJgw83rK8arbTgBZNXAk__pYZDgMxR39ZjTxf1efpvSiyfqlWdHuXtcbos39sGQx13bBU84AK7xMkrvYppkUQZzKDEhRNAK4luV0DRG-PpTzvXMtsqt6VBQ==) [howstuffworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1-Ax-_GPr3tEV18JjxJ3NqKgY3dOw0AYPN84eNglMVD2XukV5z5YjKsmSKrce5_-osE2wDsx0xk1RdyTZlu75h5Re0Qk-tZoRnJVhUXjuydci8rU8sNM4eLInzEe7Y5_dfaX1sA==). The transistor acts as a switch to read or write the charge. DRAM requires periodic refreshing to maintain data due to charge leakage, allowing for high storage densities at a lower cost [howstuffworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1-Ax-_GPr3tEV18JjxJ3NqKgY3dOw0AYPN84eNglMVD2XukV5z5YjKsmSKrce5_-osE2wDsx0xk1RdyTZlu75h5Re0Qk-tZoRnJVhUXjuydci8rU8sNM4eLInzEe7Y5_dfaX1sA==) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEeUCSR_2vm5fu5r1BgXpFW0XslD5epxKVyv8ZIugxuU3hI_0TQgnowORpA-2X9-Jsh1abVXv2Vh9jz8sWYB3DA7gHJsyyxwkHDchTi_CK-rMB-Nbxs55Y0PJN4UWeKSKEsOAhYAjw74aFHb9KsJhwBPoUWdn8=).
    *   **SRAM (Static RAM):** This uses a more complex circuit of four to six transistors (a flip-flop) to store a bit. SRAM does not require refreshing and is significantly faster than DRAM, but it is less dense and more expensive [howstuffworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG1-Ax-_GPr3tEV18JjxJ3NqKgY3dOw0AYPN84eNglMVD2XukV5z5YjKsmSKrce5_-osE2wDsx0xk1RdyTZlu75h5Re0Qk-tZoRnJVhUXjuydci8rU8sNM4eLInzEe7Y5_dfaX1sA==) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFeuXpztl0YpUxA8hwaIakSei_g9BmEkzzOwqiDGav41r5TXrI6QRo_2hKvf-Y5LtDwLsxtR6YhCEZfJ1tME5Bbiqkf49KibjpVORMk3jKOMYK9XHJxeI6OYeuCOg3DA2KiJmfUbAqYhdVoVe4UUfU1s3JQgbiqrA7XZg==). Additionally, **DNA data storage** is an experimental approach that encodes digital information into synthesized DNA molecules, offering extremely high data density and longevity [computer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGrDpfEYLXGfz5DwRFJKRQ3dGjqTCX3U9SqIrNZW0fw0xf6lIfEjFCgHOBApSONG0tGyrSDks7mQCTiBQWNJyYeX3Guvd34w9eh_LtlvcmRW8fYy4JA8ueubreTsT0nAh74fol7YZb909VVRVVuaXyUj1nQsLyF7Wvq1lAAA2aDqQ==) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHKRSIhBlHHiIy7IzhfY1JNE0dIwwitGc2WGn3vg51Zep1oiXaEwQNa2As3jOlMsRM4Igm07swQOBNGnoK5DLWcrrE2tCi34C6qGiEmU4BEgV7tX1sYTVyni-vycs8jy6v6jk9NuYiiK7_XZA==).

code.doc: Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
code.signature: (question: str, initial_queries: int = 3, max_loops: int = 2, reasoning_model: str = 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite') -> str
code.source:
@eval(project="gemini-deep-research-agent", version="v1", name="research_agent")
def run_agent(
    question: str,
    initial_queries: int = 3,
    max_loops: int = 2,
    reasoning_model: str = "gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
) -> str:
    """
    Main LLM-facing entrypoint for the research agent. Wrapped with @eval so calls are traced/stored.
    """
    state = {
        "messages": [HumanMessage(content=question)],
        "initial_search_query_count": initial_queries,
        "max_research_loops": max_loops,
        "reasoning_model": reasoning_model,
    }
    result = graph.invoke(state)
    messages = result.get("messages", [])
    return messages[-1].content if messages else ""

output:
Earthquakes are caused by a variety of geological processes, with ongoing research continually refining our understanding of these complex mechanisms.

**Natural Causes of Earthquakes:**

*   **Plate Tectonics and Fault Geometry:** The primary drivers of earthquakes are the movements of Earth's tectonic plates. However, new research suggests that the geometric complexity of fault lines plays a crucial role. Misaligned or complex fault structures can cause increased friction and pressure build-up, leading to more significant earthquakes when they eventually rupture [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHrYVnVQGe_feJLDlz8dVAbYD8QAVtaAdHYc4jd44vLp5m7z7vekOKSdWD2GiUw8fHibIFFy6XShDkn5x3pK9MmKfg-sovotZ9iqOkjp2ByR8MmztTyvAezfIvHDCuVqvEDBKZJ4plrHrbLqhMmfMeKcrzS-JeIpZaL). Oceanic plates, once thought to be rigid, are now understood to be scored by large undersea faults that can pull them apart, contributing to seismic activity [utoronto](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEPRnijt3n9S9vM5KFGUYXEA5Kh_opH8wU5o-UY557gU1tvTsW2fNDohl-O-gkvHSRkqZlUKPguhiY1wUKATjJdSG7x1Ml33BxW41TKH7gobFqQoSQNXJYPYnFzQ4pwnEYk2mWPRuEhE-5q883P6e5lVzC6zY6_k8VFpc4eWUIOgVacFTjyVg_hgyoT8i2veFzqnJVM1RwUz7lsPZ8IoonBS-YwIFfHLsDoAUZaIv6PEghEsXDggLSDCg0xoTeUlR7ZZdN6MX0=).
*   **Deep Earthquake Mechanisms:** The understanding of deep earthquakes has been advanced by events like the M7.4 Calama earthquake in Chile. This earthquake, occurring at a depth of 125 kilometers within a subducting plate, revealed a mechanism where dehydration embrittlement transitions to shear thermal runaway, allowing rapid slip even in hot, ductile rock. This challenges previous assumptions about the depth limits for earthquakes [watchers](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEh9klQuF-2vEw0z_Pbrhr9BoChm8fDJG4pGpJaqIHufRc2OjhuMcFrJ_mLIvbX0rrRyFSoieFdRgT4KSrPdfrQXhzTJZ9-JasA_yGFdaKHdPocOxyeNrV9tmi7Z0TP0moZNpL9sldD5fwEhRR1vqCCrUyQRKPH99645o4cuIub_nf0Jtdd-NovBga8mmXp_9ZGKHrrDTlTOeW0iw6VVGeNo6MnhmUMDHdklw==).
*   **Climate Change Influence:** Emerging research points to a potential link between climate change and seismic activity. Rising global sea levels, due to melting ice and thermal expansion, increase hydrostatic pressure on the Earth's crust, which can influence tectonic stress and seismic cycles [rcrusadernews](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEJHqL6A54uTGmGQFWgIADMZWNsnGLBTQ12EOK5CjwIjNUODsvvKr5wugK2KDhXcqxqnSJCpC4AZP_OnRj7Ri4tx6Pk448IKA2FZl6d_qwJSvgOhHgtjkT6GQW8rZanmOIAYWzgInpOZ91lVKic2E6U6MD502_frSIBX9tCwT1GMllAuRjsEPXIZ_9BXIg=). Similarly, the melting of large ice sheets leads to Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA), altering stress distributions and potentially increasing seismic activity as the landmass rebounds [vedur](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG2uo_NDG1ijky8DNp6gRoXykSizvDMYbvwSapCRP8elpd-CSulKpyV2i1SZnTKrHCdPXcRDobfr_jOYyyU_BwzWI-EqC9vzj6Ca-ymQ6kikvZ-9tgCq6mkfWq9OEWKcPnyEKtdNWRvXYu-tu0l-u4Uetp1-qdf6WCRKqsJ588m8f6ydl6fpxajh13x3Ho2awraRus6i0t0stelYFHYzwVeBsiHPqc59dAs0H5hloydq0VPtI54sR0SgZW7TA==).
*   **Volcanic Activity:** There is a recognized interplay between volcanic activity and seismic events. Large earthquakes can trigger volcanic eruptions, and conversely, seismic swarms beneath volcanoes often indicate magmatic or fluid movement, signaling potential unrest [jvolcanica](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE1mykUmMIu3ONMx7d2J1z0GaNbAfBEw6ClykSR-rMiOaaGKQM5Zws-ekaroflnjn0iHVX8pVJuFkGmVGOEjBOZdVqVSXQQ1UTkveB_uGSlEsNFoltt0WVFfUvnPKsF_ct2LRa_ieM3VxF3gwtKcqK8Yv1UXVifDjZBeIfDvok=). For instance, seismic activity beneath Santorini and Kīlauea in 2024 has been linked to magma intrusions and fluid movement [mcgill](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGRbvGDvygGF7qRvHlBDxXrf5mzrknvaWgV2BKKc12bKZJNtDlqwOfafnvdyr_mlmX3lGgwedJcUR_OexxLLx6VTgPw8tJ6GHVxr_NTm7T7ppPN4Iv9vpSdxNShR5qtoHb3GO9ScwES0rRxLx0Wzm8=) [usgs](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGl-r1xy27PQFaxeQLs6PPRThGAyVn-ZyVFTVHfmKnI9mC-C5_EJAPGN6NIpf0giig7Qz61ROZCOH8U04wcwo2fkgjMHcRRo196jowtKSgvxQgrGqsrsQEP6KJJYNDqPEzr32mxUn7rohtRFOV7YC8Lh-K3p8nSmPLy4YliSZT3EsB1knRowlfhvB6I28Blnpb0oUveK5zLsefX9nnq-CgDCu6X9v8=).
*   **Low-Frequency Earthquakes and Tidal Forces:** In some regions, very small, low-frequency earthquakes that respond to tidal forces from the Sun and Moon offer insights into tectonic plate motion and stress accumulation [indiandefencereview](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGIBw6-XK0XelQMFOzKcCMiNWiPNHb1Y5hZa6T0XqzrrVM1qjIhoGFk9yaMyiiwHBk5MYqYHNuzvEFO4IJB-OzYpasi9j6ROX3W7YWhidmAhBYXb5MznRNS871TECD88Z8g00zI8F-5rWKqVqKWOwqCTwkX9QR7_McMuGuuGoovG9Ml5wXrKEtZwgyGSmBIU-_iti_nCEtjnpV2fdwvLhmmRQe5I8xep21ouKXi8C6u1).

**Human-Induced Earthquakes:**

*   **Industrial Activities:** Human activities are increasingly recognized as triggers for seismic activity, often referred to as induced seismicity. These include:
    *   **Wastewater Disposal:** Injecting large volumes of wastewater into the subsurface increases pore pressure, which reduces the effective stress on faults and can trigger earthquakes. Studies in regions like the Midland Basin, Texas, have identified specific pore pressure thresholds that initiate seismic activity [geoscienceworld](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEcwQ-zyMwCZkmGqnpGwd3grF6qT9Gar0lKELQNDXRuJ44NYwVnTNcfTt-I63FRNcwjt1_JHaAtKjuvas1rO4nTxF0yIZ5o8VARf5tjOjPH-XZ34APE_gHJfJrwvNqkCv0Xuoa03kZrHuuotPCrzuDI4Com3RPx5j6oIIiT11A3W6z7ZmQ4eXwwbxVQMeC4Lxml6C-Tnp-b).
    *   **Geothermal Energy Production and Fracking:** These processes involve injecting fluids into the Earth, which can also alter pore pressure and stress conditions, leading to induced earthquakes. Poroelastic effects, the mechanical coupling between pore pressure and rock deformation, can amplify the impact of these activities [myscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGIBw6-XK0XelQMFOzKcCMiNWiPNHb1Y5hZa6T0XqzrrVM1qjIhoGFk9yaMyiiwHBk5MYqYHNuzvEFO4IJB-OzYpasi9j6ROX3W7YWhidmAhBYXb5MznRNS871TECD88Z8g00zI8F-5rWKqVqKWOwqCTwkX9QR7_McMuGuuGoovG9Ml5wXrKEtZwgyGSmBIU-_iti_nCEtjnpV2fdwvLhmmRQe5I8xep21ouKXi8C6u0).
    *   **Pore Pressure Diffusion and Poroelasticity:** The spread of fluids through subsurface rock formations (pore pressure diffusion) and the resulting stress changes (poroelasticity) are key mechanisms driving induced seismicity, particularly in wastewater disposal and geothermal operations [researchgate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQErzh2SGOaCgQU0ZU_V2X48jkiq5rQE8zMRtFAJNAdC0H2pxMaX-JwxoLZQa_8jQMHzMQ8y864FLVq94YkcUa_8islpDzeDyaBb5ts7q1ksv88_PxYi71YWXIYCFOrGigYIBoqp7ERBaYmquE-4FmBWNgH6RaFg7Jd-VV8amt6fcmOnsILqZWcEQiB0J-fjIYj5ZQTx169RUlXGGg8V-QNNL_Vice_3r1moFgMCvH7fJ-lWW5DH4Cv_om4N_VtTXP13JCxV3-oTQtY7IgKOw2I=).

In summary, earthquakes are predominantly caused by the natural movement and interaction of Earth's tectonic plates, influenced by factors like fault geometry, depth of geological processes, and even climate change. However, human activities, especially those involving fluid injection into the subsurface, can also induce seismic events by altering pore pressure and stress conditions on existing faults.

The Doppler effect, first described by physicist Christian Doppler in 1842, is the change in frequency of a wave that occurs when there is relative motion between the wave's source and an observer [ebsco](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHPuGxpr3_k-ttaKjy5_xQOwPbCqf9XwrGDlofZMy_6wKgk39FLXewT9WgDF-bI0GVVIHx1AZ1kV9iGMCtaXKMaveBc3kWni0khdn5EfBc46MbttIstOVoBTNfpvM9DwcBnd68I0sPxTHCa0wLJG0CHBIzwEGBqGrjm1RE=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHjT_n6RtjW6q0khjOX0OYOrpemgcE8CL1R88ROcARUV_OZMJxFUFlXi5Mns81SE9Kvbg0EeAKj55ownqPCwLWhV6iquGiY6Ack_azSD8XWgkfQXXWaKSCEeEfLLSAysBAyF4i6-Leb) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHdiPzaXT7MX0MvBNMpUHCzBdPhWfwN90Yo4yN_7_gHmfw-xtub1WnVZDcy0b74zjYfTA_APakhKKJ_MCQ8PxiiQGefqC8rHZ44iKV4VpRQBDoSyuaRwrwbKEy9bm8eu-c0nmCPc4rM). This phenomenon is observable across various types of waves, including sound, light, and water waves [ebsco](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHPuGxpr3_k-ttaKjy5_xQOwPbCqf9XwrGDlofZMy_6wKgk39FLXewT9WgDF-bI0GVVIHx1AZ1kV9iGMCtaXKMaveBc3kWni0khdn5EfBc46MbttIstOVoBTNfpvM9DwcBnd68I0sPxTHCa0wLJG0CHBIzwEGBqGrjm1RE=) [ebsco](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFbmRuZ8yb94XuTY-JEVP2gEDV2oRm7dQ4NNzE8OOogXgOsoHanaRYV3Q84gwPsCdG4z6uL6ogS_8NnkXDLyryBDCQoXYcFhX170v8Xbr8jvqWAZ0YZk8YJQR-F234hPR2SqAWeRe6VzgynS920Ah5n264i3wSLyMC-FCU=).

The core principle behind the Doppler effect is the relative motion between the source and the observer. When the source and observer move towards each other, the waves are compressed, resulting in an observed higher frequency and shorter wavelength. Conversely, when they move away from each other, the waves are stretched, leading to an observed lower frequency and longer wavelength [quakelogic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE3h_xs7PdJy5dT8D0BwbBxij_hGNuRLfyjTNUO4VAj6iFiyehDrrnKDVFdJ9B-2p7e9rSnoR2llXeXPnANoNO96SCqjIUiQ09NWO2AM82fmAPWZnScmG9N6h36MTEgCyQCqbOz154STQzHFVcQmU9M2ciN3ZxD1jJ5_aF887sjKqmf__WCluydGkd2_aTEXgr87q2kMsLq7xnZFQ==) [byjus](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFAh3HdtcmibnZJKWqfF8MJFGobbJBhkYf5sHYb2dO762ht7GLi_jNlZluuMfQEl4GgfV_vCFVJheyv0c8WlracDb1Nzz3WuGNJdVZNVSgEqmG4V2qPJVLA1puLxwz-SUsyqk8k) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHjT_n6RtjW6q0khjOX0OYOrpemgcE8CL1R88ROcARUV_OZMJxFUFlXi5Mns81SE9Kvbg0EeAKj55ownqPCwLWhV6iquGiY6Ack_azSD8XWgkfQXXWaKSCEeEfLLSAysBAyF4i6-Leb) [byjus](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGkkR7z-cIOgeT58k0q9QrCdmD_RMFC3RBnk-uP1yKYh9-ZAPZ3N4FzaviYH_4dNkarmuQ_lxrr_NlolQ23QvWTBu6irIOKrn87DcOp9KkliqpUfMqcxVb3-YL_cbK3YUBIprb4) [researchgate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGG5EoIisDFsxxdpwchRmWXa_6ZhVQWk-_iZ-Jsn_hy2e2kaWZ-Ht3X2O-jfWxX47J9jmwT4Ap-_LSA1eHG4bKnj7pH6dGXvrHzE1CIbTNb6PSx17D-QR95KudHwZyJge7Ecd_bAIDTjOWQjd6sgMaNi3er5msbMYVNcS2aKz1pHQCkapKTkEVp5SRlKeKkWOY3XyZ9_32xCw==). A common, easily understood example of the Doppler effect is the change in pitch of a siren from an approaching emergency vehicle.
